# Overview

End-to-end pipeline that estimates the Phase 1 mode-choice MNL described in
the methodology section of the thesis. Inputs are five external artifacts
(see YAML `params`); everything else is computed from those inputs.

The fitted model is a multinomial logit with four alternatives (drive,
walk, bike, transit) and the production specification:

```
choice ~ cost + walking_min_alt + bike_tt_alt + drive_tt_alt +
         transit_total_diff_alt + vc_drive_alt | is_work
```

where `cost` for the drive alternative is divided by trip party size
(`travelers_total`) to model cost-splitting among carpoolers,
`walking_min_alt` pools walk-mode time and walk-to-stop time on a single
generic-walking coefficient, and `transit_total_diff_alt` is
`(transit_ivtt + transit_wait) - drive_tt` (the diff specification that
identifies cleanly off within-OD time-of-day variation).

Pipeline stages:

1. Auto-install + load packages, set hardware tuning
2. Load PSRC trips + households (handles all four survey years)
3. Pull Census tract polygons, blocks, and Seattle place boundary
4. Compute population-weighted tract centroids
5. Filter to trips with both endpoints in Seattle
6. Build r5r and dodgr networks from the OSM pbf and GTFS zips
7. Compute walk, bike, transit, and drive skims (parallel + cached)
8. GAM-calibrate drive time against observed PSRC trip durations
9. Mock-fill intra-tract trips via average speeds
10. Compute parking impedance via logsum across paid-curb / garage / free candidates
11. Estimate per-household transit fare from composition + income
12. Build the choice-long table and fit the MNL
13. Save fitted model, coefficient table, VOTTs, run metadata

Every stage caches its output keyed on the hash of its upstream inputs;
re-runs with unchanged inputs reuse the cache, while changed inputs
invalidate downstream stages.

# 1. Setup

## 1a. Auto-install + load packages

```{r setup-packages, message = FALSE}
.required_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "readr", "lubridate", "purrr",
  "data.table", "progress", "digest", "jsonlite", "fs", "glue",
  "sf", "tigris", "tidycensus", "lwgeom",
  "r5r", "dodgr", "osmextract", "FNN",
  "mgcv", "mlogit", "dfidx", "forcats",
  "RcppParallel", "future", "future.apply"
)

.installed <- rownames(utils::installed.packages())
.missing <- setdiff(.required_pkgs, .installed)
if (length(.missing)) {
  message(sprintf("Installing %d missing packages: %s",
                  length(.missing), paste(.missing, collapse = ", ")))
  utils::install.packages(.missing, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org",
                          dependencies = TRUE)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(readr)
  library(lubridate); library(purrr); library(data.table); library(progress)
  library(digest); library(jsonlite); library(fs); library(glue)
  library(sf); library(tigris); library(tidycensus); library(lwgeom)
  library(r5r); library(dodgr); library(osmextract); library(FNN)
  library(mgcv); library(mlogit); library(dfidx); library(forcats)
})
```

## 1b. Hardware tuning + global options

```{r setup-hardware}
N_VCPU <- if (params$n_threads > 0) {
  as.integer(params$n_threads)
} else {
  max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE) - 1L)
}

# Java heap for r5r — leave plenty of room for other R objects.
# Empirically r5r needs ~30-50 GB for Puget Sound + GTFS at the 84k OD scale.
JAVA_HEAP_GB <- 80L
options(java.parameters = sprintf("-Xmx%dG", JAVA_HEAP_GB))

# Threading: prefer one source of parallelism per stage so threads don't
# fight. We let dodgr/r5r/data.table own the parallelism inside their
# stages, and constrain BLAS to one thread (mgcv handles its own).
data.table::setDTthreads(threads = N_VCPU)
RcppParallel::setThreadOptions(numThreads = N_VCPU)
Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS        = as.character(min(N_VCPU, 8L)),
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS   = "1",
  MKL_NUM_THREADS        = "1",
  VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
  BLIS_NUM_THREADS       = "1"
)

# sf options
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Census API key
if (nzchar(params$census_api_key)) {
  Sys.setenv(CENSUS_API_KEY = params$census_api_key)
  try(tidycensus::census_api_key(params$census_api_key,
                                 install = FALSE, overwrite = TRUE),
      silent = TRUE)
} else if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY"))) {
  warning("No Census API key supplied via params or CENSUS_API_KEY env var. ",
          "Tract / block fetches will fail. Get a key at ",
          "https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html")
}

# Output / cache dirs
CACHE_DIR  <- normalizePath(params$cache_dir, mustWork = FALSE)
OUTPUT_DIR <- normalizePath(params$output_dir, mustWork = FALSE)
dir.create(CACHE_DIR,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Pipeline configuration:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  CPU threads:    %d\n", N_VCPU))
cat(sprintf("  Java heap:      %d GB\n", JAVA_HEAP_GB))
cat(sprintf("  Cache dir:      %s\n", CACHE_DIR))
cat(sprintf("  Output dir:     %s\n", OUTPUT_DIR))
cat(sprintf("  Force rebuild:  %s\n", params$force_rebuild))
```

## 1c. Constants

All values are reported here so a reviewer can challenge any number with
one place to look. Citations are in the methodology section.

```{r setup-constants}
# Monetary parameters
DRIVE_COST_PER_MILE      <- 0.77   # AAA "Your Driving Costs" 2025 15k miles/yr car composite
TRANSIT_FARE_ADULT       <- 3.00   # KCM 2025 effective Sep 1, 2025
TRANSIT_FARE_LOWINC      <- 1.00   # reduced fare: ORCA Lift + Regional Reduced Fare (senior), both $1
TRANSIT_FARE_YOUTH       <- 0.00   # KCM youth ride free
TRANSIT_FARE_STUDENT     <- 0.00   # institutional pass approximation
TRANSIT_EMPLOYER_FREE_SHARE <- 0.59  # share of commuters with employer-paid ORCA
TRANSIT_FARE_WORKER      <- TRANSIT_FARE_ADULT * (1 - TRANSIT_EMPLOYER_FREE_SHARE)  # $3 x 0.41 = $1.23
# ORCA LIFT ceiling: gross household income <= 200% of the Federal Poverty Level
# (2025 HHS guidelines, 48 states): $15,650 for 1 person, +$5,500 each additional.
TRANSIT_FPL_BASE_USD     <- 15650
TRANSIT_FPL_PER_PERSON   <- 5500
TRANSIT_LIFT_FPL_MULT    <- 2.0

# r5r / dodgr routing limits
R5_MAX_TRIP_MIN          <- 180L
R5_MAX_WALK_MIN          <- 180L
R5_MAX_BIKE_MIN          <- 180L
R5_MAX_CAR_MIN           <- 180L
TRANSIT_ROUTING_WALK_MIN <- 45L     # max walk per leg in transit routing
TRANSIT_ROUTING_TOTAL_MIN<- 180L
MAX_TRANSIT_RIDES        <- 4L

# Transit feasibility thresholds for choice-set availability
MAX_TRANSIT_WALK_MIN     <- 45
MAX_TRANSIT_WAIT_MIN     <- 60
MAX_TRANSIT_TOTAL_MIN    <- 180

# Transit skim: 20-min window centered on the representative hour.
TRANSIT_WINDOW_PRE       <- 10L
TRANSIT_WINDOW_POST      <- 10L
TRANSIT_TIME_WINDOW      <- TRANSIT_WINDOW_PRE + TRANSIT_WINDOW_POST

# Chunk sizes for routing (tuned for 16 vCPUs / 110 GB RAM)
R5_PAIR_CHUNK_SIZE        <- 2000L
TRANSIT_ORIGIN_CHUNK_SIZE <- 200L

# Parking impedance (see methodology)
PARK_VOT_USD_PER_HR              <- 28.54  # Seattle value of time ($/hr)
PARK_GARAGE_DEFAULT_USD_PER_HR   <- list(downtown = 8.0, non_downtown = 3.0)
PARK_WALK_SPEED_M_PER_MIN        <- 80
PARK_CIRCUITY                    <- 1.4
PARK_CURB_OCCUPANCY              <- 0.85   # SDOT performance-pricing target ceiling
PARK_CURB_WALK_M                 <- 40     # half average Seattle block width
PARK_GARAGE_ACCESS_MIN           <- 2.0    # Ricker BTS rosap, half store+deliver
PARK_MAX_CANDIDATE_M             <- 800    # 0.5 mi walk-shed
# Parking-choice dispersion = walk time across the 0.5-mi candidate radius
# (800 m / 80 m per min = 10 min). The Gumbel scale theta is set so the SD of
# each option's unobserved preference equals that dispersion: SD = theta*pi/sqrt(6).
PARK_LOGSUM_DISPERSION_MIN       <- PARK_MAX_CANDIDATE_M / PARK_WALK_SPEED_M_PER_MIN  # = 10 min
PARK_LOGSUM_THETA_MIN            <- PARK_LOGSUM_DISPERSION_MIN * sqrt(6) / pi          # ~ 7.80 min
PARK_RPZ_DIFFICULTY_MULTIPLIER   <- 2.0
PARK_RPZ_LIMIT_HR                <- 2.0    # RPZ non-permit visitor time limit (hours)
PARK_MAX_DWELL_HR                <- 12     # cap parking dwell (long "dwells" are HTS artifacts)
PARK_MIN_UNPAID_SHARE            <- 0.10

# Numerical guards
MIN_POSITIVE_MI  <- 1e-3

# Reference Monday (must lie inside GTFS validity)
BASE_MONDAY <- as.Date(params$base_monday)

# Day-of-week ordering used to project HTS travel_dow → calendar date
DOW_LEVELS <- c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday",
                "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")

# CRS choices: 4326 for r5r/lon-lat, 32610 (UTM 10N) for metric ops
CRS_LL    <- 4326
CRS_PLANAR <- 32610
```

## 1d. Helpers

```{r setup-helpers}
# Verbose timestamped logging. Every stage uses these so the run log is
# uniformly readable. log_stage() opens a new section; log_msg() inside.
.log_start_time <- Sys.time()

# Mirrored to a plain log file so a headless render can be followed live
# (run_pipeline.R sets PIPELINE_LOG; the default is logs/phase1_progress.log).
.RUN_LOG <- Sys.getenv("PIPELINE_LOG", file.path(getwd(), "logs", "phase1_progress.log"))
dir.create(dirname(.RUN_LOG), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
try(cat("", file = .RUN_LOG), silent = TRUE)   # truncate at the start of each run
.tee <- function(txt) {
  cat(txt)
  try(cat(txt, file = .RUN_LOG, append = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
}

log_stage <- function(stage) {
  sep <- paste(rep("=", 76), collapse = "")
  .tee(sprintf("\n%s\n[%s] %s\n%s\n", sep,
               format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), stage, sep))
}

log_msg <- function(...) {
  .tee(sprintf("[%s] %s\n", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"),
               paste0(..., collapse = "")))
}

log_done <- function(label, t0) {
  dt <- difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")
  .tee(sprintf("[%s] DONE %s (%.1f sec)\n",
               format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), label, as.numeric(dt)))
}

# Cache: hash inputs and store on disk. with_cache() takes a label, an
# arbitrary list of inputs (hashed via digest::digest), and a builder
# closure; if the cache file exists AND the input hash matches the stored
# manifest, returns the cached object, else rebuilds + caches.
with_cache <- function(label, inputs, builder) {
  hash <- digest::digest(list(label = label, inputs = inputs),
                         algo = "sha1")
  payload_path <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, sprintf("%s_%s.rds", label, hash))
  manifest_path <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, sprintf("%s_%s.json", label, hash))

  if (!params$force_rebuild &&
      file.exists(payload_path) && file.exists(manifest_path)) {
    log_msg(sprintf("Cache HIT  for %s [%s]", label, substr(hash, 1, 8)))
    return(readRDS(payload_path))
  }

  log_msg(sprintf("Cache MISS for %s [%s] -- building", label,
                  substr(hash, 1, 8)))
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  obj <- builder()
  saveRDS(obj, payload_path)
  jsonlite::write_json(
    list(label = label, hash = hash,
         built_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
         seconds = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))),
    manifest_path, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE
  )
  log_done(sprintf("cached %s", label), t0)
  obj
}

# File hash for cache invalidation. Hash size + mtime (cheap) is enough for
# our purposes — full content hash on multi-GB pbfs would be prohibitive.
file_signature <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(list(path = path, exists = FALSE))
  fi <- file.info(path)
  list(path = path, size = fi$size, mtime = format(fi$mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
}

# 11-digit GEOID cleaner (state+county+tract).
clean_geoid11 <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace_all(as.character(x), "[^0-9]", "")
  substr(str_pad(x, 11, pad = "0"), 1, 11)
}

# PSRC mode_class → 4-mode taxonomy (drive includes ride-hail; bike
# includes micromobility/e-scooter).
normalize_mode <- function(mode_class) {
  m <- toupper(str_squish(as.character(mode_class)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(m, "WALK")                  ~ "walk",
    str_detect(m, "BIKE|BICYCLE|MICROMOB") ~ "bike",
    str_detect(m, "TRANSIT")               ~ "transit",
    str_detect(m, "DRIVE|AUTO|CAR|HAIL")   ~ "drive",
    TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# PSRC time-of-day buckets (PSRC 2009 Travel Demand Forecasting).
tod_bin <- function(h) {
  h <- as.integer(h)
  case_when(
    h >= 6  & h < 10 ~ "AM",
    h >= 10 & h < 16 ~ "Midday",
    h >= 16 & h < 19 ~ "PM",
    h >= 19 & h < 23 ~ "Evening",
    TRUE             ~ "Night"
  )
}

dow_type_from_date <- function(x) {
  ifelse(lubridate::wday(x, week_start = 1) %in% c(6, 7), "Weekend", "Weekday")
}

# Income bucket text → midpoint in $1000. PSRC HTS uses strings like
# "Under $10,000", "$25,000-$49,999", "$200,000 or more".
parse_income_midpoint_k <- function(x) {
  s <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  s2 <- str_replace_all(s, "[$,]", "")
  lo <- readr::parse_number(str_extract(s2, "^\\d+"))
  hi <- readr::parse_number(str_extract(s2, "(?<=-)\\d+"))
  out <- case_when(
    is.na(s) ~ NA_real_,
    str_detect(s2, regex("prefer not|dont know|don't know", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ NA_real_,
    str_detect(s2, regex("^under\\s*\\d+", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ hi / 2,
    str_detect(s2, regex("or more", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ lo + 50000,
    !is.na(lo) & !is.na(hi) ~ (lo + hi) / 2,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
  out / 1000
}

# PSRC HTS encodes travelers_total as text ("1 traveler", "5+ travelers",
# "Missing Response"), and the column also suffers occasional CSV-parsing
# corruption (column 56 mode_other_specify can contain unescaped commas
# that shift columns rightward). Parse only the canonical "N traveler(s)"
# form; everything else → NA → impute median below.
parse_travelers <- function(x) {
  m <- stringr::str_match(as.character(x),
                          "^\\s*([0-9]+)\\+?\\s*travelers?\\s*$")
  as.integer(m[, 2])
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(stats::median(x))
}

weighted_mean_safe <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  weighted.mean(x[ok], w[ok])
}

chunk_indices <- function(n, chunk_size) {
  if (n == 0) return(list())
  split(seq_len(n), ceiling(seq_len(n) / chunk_size))
}

# Convert dollars to minutes via assumed VOT (used only inside the
# parking logsum, not the upper-level MNL).
usd_to_min <- function(usd, vot_usd_per_hr = PARK_VOT_USD_PER_HR) {
  usd / vot_usd_per_hr * 60
}

walk_min_from_m <- function(d_m) {
  pmax(d_m, 0) * PARK_CIRCUITY / PARK_WALK_SPEED_M_PER_MIN
}

# Shoup-shape parking search time: flat at low occupancy, rises sharply
# past the SDOT 85% target. Boundaries are inclusive on the upper edge.
search_min_from_occ <- function(occ) {
  case_when(
    is.na(occ)  ~ 2.0,
    occ <= 0.70 ~ 0.5,
    occ <= 0.80 ~ 1.5,
    occ <= 0.85 ~ 3.0,
    occ <= 0.90 ~ 5.0,
    occ <= 0.95 ~ 8.0,
    TRUE        ~ 12.0
  )
}

# Logit-style logsum across parking candidates, returns generalized cost
# in minutes (lower is better).
parking_logsum <- function(candidate_cost_min, theta = PARK_LOGSUM_THETA_MIN) {
  ok <- is.finite(candidate_cost_min)
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  c <- candidate_cost_min[ok]
  -theta * log(sum(exp(-c / theta)))
}

# Expected attribute under the parking logit (used to recover expected
# money / search / walk components corresponding to the chosen candidate).
expected_under_logit <- function(value, candidate_cost_min,
                                 theta = PARK_LOGSUM_THETA_MIN) {
  ok <- is.finite(candidate_cost_min) & is.finite(value)
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  c <- candidate_cost_min[ok]
  v <- value[ok]
  w <- exp(-c / theta)
  sum(v * w) / sum(w)
}

# Number of forced relocations ("re-parks") during a stay of dwell_hr under a
# posted time limit of limit_hr. Zero when the limit is missing or non-binding.
reparks <- function(dwell_hr, limit_hr) {
  n <- ceiling(dwell_hr / limit_hr) - 1
  n[!is.finite(limit_hr) | limit_hr <= 0] <- 0
  pmax(0, n)
}

# Length-weighted median (used to summarise blockface time limits per tract).
weighted_median <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  x <- x[ok]; w <- w[ok]
  o <- order(x); x <- x[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w[o]) / sum(w)
  x[which(cw >= 0.5)[1]]
}

# Total garage price for a stay of dwell_hr from the duration-tiered schedule
# (RTE_1HR/2HR/3HR/ALLDAY are cumulative totals; pick the smallest tier that
# covers the stay, capped at all-day). NA if no tier is known.
garage_money_tiered <- function(dwell_hr, r1, r2, r3, rall) {
  base <- case_when(
    dwell_hr <= 1 ~ coalesce(r1, r2, r3, rall),
    dwell_hr <= 2 ~ coalesce(r2, r3, rall, r1),
    dwell_hr <= 3 ~ coalesce(r3, rall, r2, r1),
    TRUE          ~ coalesce(rall, r3, r2, r1)
  )
  pmin(base, coalesce(rall, base))
}

# Read an ArcGIS FeatureServer query layer that exceeds maxRecordCount, by
# paging on resultOffset (ordered by OBJECTID for stable paging). Each page is
# downloaded to a local .geojson file first -- reading straight from the URL is
# unreliable here (GDAL can return empty geometry / dropped CRS). CRS is forced
# from the requested outSR=4326 as a safety net. Assumes a line layer.
read_arcgis_paged <- function(base_url, page = 2000L) {
  pages <- list(); off <- 0L
  repeat {
    u  <- sprintf("%s&resultOffset=%d&resultRecordCount=%d&orderByFields=OBJECTID",
                  base_url, off, page)
    tf <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson")
    ok <- tryCatch({ utils::download.file(u, tf, quiet = TRUE, mode = "wb"); TRUE },
                   error = function(e) FALSE)
    chunk <- if (isTRUE(ok) && file.exists(tf) && file.size(tf) > 0L)
      tryCatch(sf::st_read(tf, quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
    if (file.exists(tf)) unlink(tf)
    if (is.null(chunk) || nrow(chunk) == 0L) break
    pages[[length(pages) + 1L]] <- sf::st_cast(chunk, "MULTILINESTRING", warn = FALSE)
    if (nrow(chunk) < page) break
    off <- off + page
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, pages)
  if (!is.null(out) && is.na(sf::st_crs(out))) sf::st_crs(out) <- 4326L
  out
}

# r5r helper: prune extra args so calls work across r5r versions.
ettm_safe <- function(...) {
  args <- list(...)
  fmls <- names(formals(r5r::expanded_travel_time_matrix))
  args <- args[names(args) %in% fmls]
  do.call(r5r::expanded_travel_time_matrix, args)
}

# Unified r5r itinerary computation for walk/bike/car. Used for the
# non-transit modes where we just need (origin, dest, time, distance).
compute_pairwise_r5_itineraries <- function(r5r_network,
                                            od_pairs,
                                            points_df,
                                            mode,
                                            departure_datetime,
                                            label,
                                            mode_egress = "WALK",
                                            time_window = 1L,
                                            max_walk_time = Inf,
                                            max_bike_time = Inf,
                                            max_car_time = Inf,
                                            max_trip_duration = R5_MAX_TRIP_MIN,
                                            max_rides = MAX_TRANSIT_RIDES,
                                            shortest_path = TRUE,
                                            chunk_size = R5_PAIR_CHUNK_SIZE) {
  od_pairs <- od_pairs %>%
    distinct(origin_id, dest_id) %>%
    mutate(origin_id = as.character(origin_id),
           dest_id   = as.character(dest_id))
  if (nrow(od_pairs) == 0) {
    return(tibble(origin_id = character(), dest_id = character(),
                  tt_min = numeric(), dist_m = numeric()))
  }
  idx_chunks <- chunk_indices(nrow(od_pairs), chunk_size)
  pb <- progress::progress_bar$new(
    format = paste0(label, " [:bar] :percent | eta: :eta | :message"),
    total  = length(idx_chunks), clear = FALSE, width = 80)

  detailed_safe <- function(...) {
    args <- list(...)
    fmls <- names(formals(r5r::detailed_itineraries))
    args <- args[names(args) %in% fmls]
    do.call(r5r::detailed_itineraries, args)
  }

  out <- vector("list", length(idx_chunks))
  for (k in seq_along(idx_chunks)) {
    sub <- od_pairs[idx_chunks[[k]], , drop = FALSE]
    origins_sub <- sub %>%
      left_join(points_df, by = c("origin_id" = "id")) %>%
      transmute(id = origin_id, lon, lat)
    dests_sub <- sub %>%
      left_join(points_df, by = c("dest_id" = "id")) %>%
      transmute(id = dest_id, lon, lat)
    ok <- complete.cases(origins_sub) & complete.cases(dests_sub)
    if (any(ok)) {
      det <- detailed_safe(
        r5r_network = r5r_network,
        origins = origins_sub[ok, , drop = FALSE],
        destinations = dests_sub[ok, , drop = FALSE],
        mode = mode, mode_egress = mode_egress,
        departure_datetime = departure_datetime,
        time_window = time_window, shortest_path = shortest_path,
        all_to_all = FALSE, drop_geometry = TRUE,
        max_walk_time = max_walk_time, max_bike_time = max_bike_time,
        max_car_time = max_car_time,
        max_trip_duration = max_trip_duration, max_rides = max_rides,
        n_threads = N_VCPU, progress = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
      dt <- data.table::as.data.table(det)
      if (nrow(dt) > 0) {
        out[[k]] <- dt[, .(tt_min = safe_median(total_duration),
                           dist_m = safe_median(total_distance)),
                       by = .(from_id, to_id)] %>%
          as_tibble() %>%
          transmute(origin_id = from_id, dest_id = to_id, tt_min, dist_m)
      }
    }
    pb$tick(tokens = list(message = sprintf("chunk %d/%d", k, length(idx_chunks))))
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

# dodgr pairwise time/distance — drops args that the current version of
# dodgr doesn't accept (varies across releases). Pass extra hints (e.g.
# parallel = TRUE) and they'll be silently ignored if unsupported.
.has_formal <- function(fn, arg) arg %in% names(formals(fn))

call_with_supported_args <- function(fn, ...) {
  args <- list(...)
  fmls <- names(formals(fn))
  args <- args[names(args) %in% fmls]
  do.call(fn, args)
}

dodgr_pairwise <- function(graph, from, to, fun = dodgr::dodgr_times) {
  if (.has_formal(fun, "pairwise")) {
    as.numeric(call_with_supported_args(
      fun, graph = graph, from = from, to = to,
      shortest = FALSE, pairwise = TRUE,
      parallel = TRUE, quiet = TRUE))
  } else {
    u_from <- unique(from); u_to <- unique(to)
    mat <- call_with_supported_args(
      fun, graph = graph, from = u_from, to = u_to,
      shortest = FALSE, parallel = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
    fi <- match(from, rownames(mat))
    ti <- match(to, colnames(mat))
    as.numeric(mat[cbind(fi, ti)])
  }
}

# Population-weighted tract centroid from block-level pop polygons.
compute_pop_weighted_tract_points <- function(blocks_sf, tracts_sf) {
  blocks_sf <- st_transform(blocks_sf, CRS_PLANAR)
  block_pts <- st_point_on_surface(blocks_sf)
  xy <- st_coordinates(block_pts)
  tmp <- blocks_sf %>%
    mutate(X = xy[, 1], Y = xy[, 2],
           pop = coalesce(as.numeric(pop), 0)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(tract_geoid) %>%
    summarise(
      pop_sum = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE),
      Xw = if_else(pop_sum > 0, sum(X * pop, na.rm = TRUE) / pop_sum,
                   mean(X, na.rm = TRUE)),
      Yw = if_else(pop_sum > 0, sum(Y * pop, na.rm = TRUE) / pop_sum,
                   mean(Y, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop")
  pts <- st_as_sf(tmp, coords = c("Xw", "Yw"), crs = CRS_PLANAR) %>%
    st_transform(CRS_LL) %>%
    transmute(GEOID = tract_geoid, geometry = geometry)
  missing <- setdiff(tracts_sf$GEOID, pts$GEOID)
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    fallback <- tracts_sf %>% filter(GEOID %in% missing) %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL) %>%
      mutate(geometry = st_point_on_surface(geometry)) %>%
      select(GEOID, geometry)
    pts <- bind_rows(pts, fallback)
  }
  pts
}

make_points_df <- function(points_sf, id_col = "GEOID") {
  pts <- st_transform(points_sf, CRS_LL)
  xy  <- st_coordinates(pts)
  tibble(id = as.character(pts[[id_col]]), lon = xy[, 1], lat = xy[, 2])
}

# osmdata_sc helpers — only used if a folder of pre-cached SC tiles is
# supplied. SC format (silicate) is required for turn penalties in dodgr.
is_osmdata_sc <- function(x) {
  inherits(x, "osmdata_sc") || inherits(x, "SC") || inherits(x, "sc")
}

merge_osmdata_sc_safe <- function(xs) {
  xs <- Filter(is_osmdata_sc, xs)
  if (!length(xs)) stop("No valid osmdata_sc tiles to merge.")
  out <- tryCatch(Reduce(c, xs), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(out)) return(out)
  out <- xs[[1]]
  for (i in 2:length(xs)) {
    xi <- xs[[i]]
    nms <- intersect(names(out), names(xi))
    for (nm in nms) {
      if (is.data.frame(out[[nm]]) && is.data.frame(xi[[nm]])) {
        out[[nm]] <- data.table::rbindlist(list(out[[nm]], xi[[nm]]),
                                           use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
        out[[nm]] <- unique(out[[nm]])
      }
    }
  }
  out
}
```

# 2. Load PSRC trips + households

The methodology specifies fields drawn from each table; we restrict to
exactly those plus the few extras needed for parking and fare estimation.
PSRC trip ids exceed 2^31 so they must be stored as numeric, not integer.

```{r load-trips}
log_stage("Stage 2: Load PSRC trips + households")

stopifnot(file.exists(params$trips_csv))
stopifnot(file.exists(params$households_csv))

log_msg(sprintf("Reading trips CSV: %s (%.1f MB)",
                params$trips_csv,
                file.info(params$trips_csv)$size / 1024^2))
trips_raw <- data.table::fread(params$trips_csv, showProgress = TRUE)

log_msg(sprintf("Reading households CSV: %s (%.1f MB)",
                params$households_csv,
                file.info(params$households_csv)$size / 1024^2))
hh_raw <- data.table::fread(params$households_csv, showProgress = TRUE)

log_msg(sprintf("Trips raw: %d rows, %d columns", nrow(trips_raw), ncol(trips_raw)))
log_msg(sprintf("Households raw: %d rows, %d columns", nrow(hh_raw), ncol(hh_raw)))

# Re-pull travelers_total via regex; it must come from raw because the
# transmute below would otherwise interpret garbage values as NA silently.
trips_raw[, travelers_total_parsed := parse_travelers(travelers_total)]
n_legit_trav <- sum(!is.na(trips_raw$travelers_total_parsed))
log_msg(sprintf("travelers_total: %d/%d (%.1f%%) parse to canonical 'N traveler(s)'",
                n_legit_trav, nrow(trips_raw),
                100 * n_legit_trav / nrow(trips_raw)))

trips <- trips_raw %>%
  transmute(
    trip_id          = as.numeric(trip_id),     # PRESERVE PSRC id (>2^31)
    household_id     = as.integer(household_id),
    depart_dow       = as.character(travel_dow),
    depart_hour      = as.integer(depart_time_hour),
    dwell_mins       = as.numeric(dwell_mins),
    dest_purpose     = as.character(dest_purpose),
    dest_purpose_cat = as.character(dest_purpose_cat),
    origin_id        = clean_geoid11(origin_tract20),
    dest_id          = clean_geoid11(dest_tract20),
    distance_miles   = as.numeric(distance_miles),
    duration_minutes = as.numeric(duration_minutes),
    mode_class       = as.character(mode_class),
    mode_norm        = normalize_mode(mode_class),
    travelers_total  = travelers_total_parsed
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mode_norm),
         is.finite(distance_miles), distance_miles > 0,
         is.finite(duration_minutes), duration_minutes > 0,
         !is.na(origin_id), !is.na(dest_id),
         !is.na(depart_hour), depart_hour %in% 0:23,
         !is.na(depart_dow)) %>%
  mutate(
    dow_i        = match(depart_dow, DOW_LEVELS),
    depart_date  = BASE_MONDAY + (dow_i - 1L),
    depart_dt    = as.POSIXct(depart_date, tz = "America/Los_Angeles") +
                   depart_hour * 3600,
    tod_bin      = tod_bin(depart_hour),
    dow_type     = dow_type_from_date(depart_date),
    travelers_total = pmin(coalesce(travelers_total, 1L), 5L)
  )

log_msg(sprintf("Trips after canonical filter: %d rows", nrow(trips)))
log_msg("Mode distribution among kept trips:")
print(trips %>% count(mode_norm) %>% arrange(desc(n)))

households <- hh_raw %>%
  transmute(
    household_id      = as.integer(household_id),
    vehicle_count_n   = readr::parse_number(as.character(vehicle_count)),
    numchildren       = readr::parse_number(as.character(numchildren)),
    numworkers        = readr::parse_number(as.character(numworkers)),
    num_students      = readr::parse_number(as.character(num_students)),
    numadults         = readr::parse_number(as.character(numadults)),
    lifecycle_class   = as.character(lifecycle_class),
    hhincome_detailed = as.character(hhincome_detailed),
    income_k          = parse_income_midpoint_k(hhincome_detailed)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    vehicle_count_n = coalesce(vehicle_count_n, 0),
    numchildren     = coalesce(numchildren, 0),
    numworkers      = coalesce(numworkers, 0),
    num_students    = coalesce(num_students, 0),
    numadults       = pmax(coalesce(numadults, 1), 1)
  )

log_msg(sprintf("Households parsed: %d rows", nrow(households)))
log_msg("Vehicle count distribution:")
print(households %>% count(vehicle_count_n) %>% arrange(vehicle_count_n))
log_msg(sprintf("Income parse rate: %.1f%% of households",
                100 * mean(!is.na(households$income_k))))

trips <- trips %>% left_join(households, by = "household_id")
log_msg(sprintf("Trips joined to households: %d rows", nrow(trips)))
```

# 3. Census geography and Seattle filter

Tract polygons via `tigris::tracts()`, decennial-census block populations
via `tidycensus::get_decennial()`, Seattle place boundary via
`tigris::places()`. All cached to avoid re-hitting the API.

```{r census-tracts}
log_stage("Stage 3: Census geography (tracts + blocks + Seattle boundary)")

tract_ids_all <- unique(c(trips$origin_id, trips$dest_id))
state_fips <- unique(substr(tract_ids_all, 1, 2))
county_fips <- unique(substr(tract_ids_all, 3, 5))
stopifnot(length(state_fips) == 1)
log_msg(sprintf("Tract universe: %d unique tracts spanning state %s, %d counties",
                length(tract_ids_all), state_fips, length(county_fips)))

tracts_sf <- with_cache("tracts_sf",
  list(state_fips = state_fips, county_fips = county_fips,
       tract_count = length(tract_ids_all)),
  function() {
    log_msg(sprintf("Fetching tract polygons for %d counties via tigris...",
                    length(county_fips)))
    bind_rows(lapply(county_fips, function(cty) {
      tigris::tracts(state = state_fips, county = cty, year = 2020,
                     cb = TRUE, class = "sf") %>% select(GEOID)
    })) %>%
      st_make_valid() %>%
      filter(GEOID %in% tract_ids_all) %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL)
  })
log_msg(sprintf("Tract polygons loaded: %d", nrow(tracts_sf)))

seattle_sf <- with_cache("seattle_place",
  list(state_fips = state_fips),
  function() {
    log_msg("Fetching Seattle place boundary via tigris::places...")
    tigris::places(state = state_fips, year = 2020, cb = TRUE,
                   class = "sf") %>%
      filter(NAME == "Seattle") %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL) %>%
      st_make_valid()
  })
log_msg(sprintf("Seattle place geometry: %d feature", nrow(seattle_sf)))

# Decennial blocks for population-weighted centroid.
blocks_sf <- with_cache("blocks_sf",
  list(state_fips = state_fips, county_fips = county_fips,
       tract_count = length(tract_ids_all)),
  function() {
    log_msg(sprintf("Fetching decennial-census block populations across %d counties...",
                    length(county_fips)))
    pb <- progress::progress_bar$new(
      format = "blocks [:bar] :percent | :message",
      total  = length(county_fips), clear = FALSE, width = 70)
    purrr::map_dfr(county_fips, function(cty) {
      pb$tick(tokens = list(message = sprintf("county %s", cty)))
      x <- tidycensus::get_decennial(
        geography = "block", variables = c(pop = "P1_001N"),
        state = state_fips, county = cty, year = 2020,
        geometry = TRUE, output = "wide")
      x$tract_geoid <- substr(x$GEOID, 1, 11)
      x %>%
        transmute(GEOID, tract_geoid,
                  pop = as.numeric(pop), geometry) %>%
        filter(tract_geoid %in% tract_ids_all)
    }) %>% st_make_valid()
  })
log_msg(sprintf("Blocks loaded: %d (across %d tracts)",
                nrow(blocks_sf), n_distinct(blocks_sf$tract_geoid)))
```

```{r centroids-and-filter}
log_stage("Stage 4: Population-weighted centroids + filter to intra-Seattle")

tract_points_sf <- with_cache("tract_centroids",
  list(blocks_signature = digest::digest(blocks_sf),
       tracts_signature = digest::digest(tracts_sf)),
  function() {
    log_msg("Computing population-weighted tract centroids from blocks...")
    compute_pop_weighted_tract_points(blocks_sf, tracts_sf)
  })

points_df <- make_points_df(tract_points_sf, id_col = "GEOID")
log_msg(sprintf("Centroids: %d points (lon/lat)", nrow(points_df)))

# Tag each tract with whether it intersects Seattle.
seattle_tract_ids <- tracts_sf %>%
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(., seattle_sf)) > 0) %>%
  pull(GEOID)
log_msg(sprintf("Seattle-overlapping tracts: %d", length(seattle_tract_ids)))

trips_seattle <- trips %>%
  filter(origin_id %in% seattle_tract_ids,
         dest_id   %in% seattle_tract_ids)
log_msg(sprintf("Intra-Seattle trips (both endpoints in Seattle): %d (%.1f%% of total)",
                nrow(trips_seattle),
                100 * nrow(trips_seattle) / nrow(trips)))
log_msg("Mode share among intra-Seattle trips:")
print(trips_seattle %>%
        count(mode_norm) %>%
        mutate(share = round(n / sum(n), 3)) %>%
        arrange(desc(n)))

# OD pair set fed into all routing engines downstream.
od_pairs <- trips_seattle %>%
  distinct(origin_id, dest_id) %>%
  mutate(origin_id = as.character(origin_id),
         dest_id   = as.character(dest_id))
log_msg(sprintf("Unique OD pairs to skim: %d", nrow(od_pairs)))
```

# 4. Build routing networks

## 4a. r5r network (walk + bike + transit, also drive fallback)

```{r build-r5}
log_stage("Stage 5a: Build r5r network from OSM pbf + GTFS feed(s)")

# r5r builds its network inside the folder that holds its inputs, so the
# routing folder lives in the cache and holds hard links to the OSM extract
# and the GTFS feed (osmextract's .gpkg conversion of the extract lands there too).
routing_dir <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "r5r_phase1")
dir.create(routing_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
link_input <- function(src) {
  src <- normalizePath(src, mustWork = TRUE)
  dst <- file.path(routing_dir, basename(src))
  if (!file.exists(dst) || file.info(dst)$size != file.info(src)$size) {
    unlink(dst)
    if (!isTRUE(file.link(src, dst))) file.copy(src, dst)
  }
  dst
}
pbf_files  <- link_input(params$osm_pbf)
gtfs_files <- link_input(params$gtfs_zip)
log_msg(sprintf("OSM pbf: %s (%.0f MB)",
                basename(pbf_files), file.info(pbf_files)$size / 1024^2))
log_msg(sprintf("GTFS feeds (%d): %s",
                length(gtfs_files),
                paste(basename(gtfs_files), collapse = ", ")))

# r5r writes a network.dat alongside the inputs in routing_dir; that
# IS the cache. If absent or older than any input, rebuild.
network_dat <- file.path(routing_dir, "network.dat")
inputs_newer_than_network <- if (file.exists(network_dat)) {
  any(file.info(c(pbf_files, gtfs_files))$mtime >
      file.info(network_dat)$mtime)
} else {
  TRUE
}
if (params$force_rebuild || inputs_newer_than_network) {
  log_msg("Building r5r network (this can take 10-30 min on first run)...")
  if (file.exists(network_dat)) file.remove(network_dat)
}

t0 <- Sys.time()
r5r_network <- r5r::build_network(data_path = routing_dir,
                                  verbose = TRUE, overwrite = FALSE)
log_done("r5r network ready", t0)

DEP_ANY <- as.POSIXct(paste0(BASE_MONDAY, " 12:00:00"),
                      tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
```

## 4b. dodgr drive graph

Two construction paths:

* **Preferred** — if `params$osm_tiles_sc_dir` points at a folder of cached
  `osmdata_sc` tile RDS files, merge them and weight (turn penalties OFF).
  Empirically, enabling turn penalties on the merged Puget Sound graph
  causes ~50% of intra-Seattle OD pairs to fail routing due to
  phantom-vertex artifacts and malformed OSM turn-restriction relations.
  The GAM calibration on observed drive times absorbs the systematic
  accuracy loss from missing turn penalties (Phase 1 model coefficients
  change <5% with vs without).
* **Fallback** — read the local `.osm.pbf` via `osmextract::oe_read`
  (clipped to a buffered bbox around the routing points). Same
  no-turn-penalty rationale.

```{r build-dodgr}
log_stage("Stage 5b: Build dodgr drive graph")

# Resolve SC-tile path: empty means skip, dir + .rds files means use them.
sc_tiles_dir <- params$osm_tiles_sc_dir
if (nzchar(sc_tiles_dir)) {
  sc_tiles_dir <- normalizePath(sc_tiles_dir, mustWork = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(sc_tiles_dir)) sc_tiles_dir <- ""
}
sc_tile_files <- if (nzchar(sc_tiles_dir)) {
  list.files(sc_tiles_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
} else character()

use_sc_path <- length(sc_tile_files) > 0
log_msg(sprintf("dodgr build path: %s",
                if (use_sc_path)
                  sprintf("SC tiles (%d files in %s)",
                          length(sc_tile_files), sc_tiles_dir)
                else
                  "osmextract pbf fallback"))

dodgr_cache_inputs <- if (use_sc_path) {
  list(
    # version tag history:
    #   v1: contracted + turn_penalty=TRUE — silently broke turn behavior
    #   v2_no_contract: uncontracted + turn_penalty=TRUE — ~50% routing failures
    #   v3_no_turn: contracted + turn_penalty=FALSE — clean routing, GAM
    #     absorbs the accuracy loss
    # Bumping the version tag invalidates older caches automatically.
    version = "v3_no_turn",
    path = "sc_tiles",
    tiles = lapply(sc_tile_files, file_signature)
  )
} else {
  list(
    version = "v3_no_turn",
    path = "pbf",
    pbf = file_signature(pbf_files),
    bbox = sf::st_bbox(sf::st_as_sf(points_df,
                                    coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                    crs = CRS_LL))
  )
}

dodgr_graph <- with_cache("dodgr_motorcar", dodgr_cache_inputs, function() {
  if (use_sc_path) {
    # ---- SC-tile path with turn penalties --------------------------------
    log_msg(sprintf("Loading %d SC tile RDS files...", length(sc_tile_files)))
    t1 <- Sys.time()
    tiles <- lapply(seq_along(sc_tile_files), function(i) {
      x <- tryCatch(readRDS(sc_tile_files[i]), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is_osmdata_sc(x)) x else NULL
    })
    tiles <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tiles)
    log_done(sprintf("loaded %d valid SC tiles", length(tiles)), t1)
    if (length(tiles) == 0)
      stop("No valid osmdata_sc tiles in ", sc_tiles_dir)

    log_msg("Merging SC tiles into a single streetnet...")
    t2 <- Sys.time()
    merged_sc <- merge_osmdata_sc_safe(tiles)
    log_done("merged SC streetnet", t2)

    # turn_penalty = FALSE: enabling turn penalties on the Puget Sound OSM
    # extract caused ~50% of intra-Seattle OD pairs to fail routing
    # (verified empirically with 20 sample failed pairs from a prior run):
    #   - 50% asymmetric failure: phantom-vertex artifacts blocking some
    #     directions (centroid snap caught a vertex with one-way exit/entry)
    #   - 40% truly unroutable: malformed OSM turn-restriction relations
    #     became graph-isolating edge bans
    #   - 10% trivial intra-tract pairs (origin == dest, t = 0)
    # The GAM calibration on observed PSRC drive times absorbs the
    # accuracy loss from missing turn penalties; coefficients change <5%
    # vs the turn-penalty version.
    log_msg("Weighting graph (motorcar profile, turn penalties = FALSE)...")
    t3 <- Sys.time()
    g <- dodgr::weight_streetnet(merged_sc, wt_profile = "motorcar",
                                 turn_penalty = FALSE)
    log_msg(sprintf("Raw graph: %d edges", nrow(g)))

    log_msg("Restricting to largest connected component...")
    g <- g[g$component == 1, ]
    log_msg(sprintf("Largest component: %d edges", nrow(g)))

    # Without turn penalties, contraction is safe and improves routing
    # speed substantially.
    log_msg("Contracting graph (collapses degree-2 chains)...")
    g_c <- dodgr::dodgr_contract_graph(g)
    log_done(sprintf("contracted graph: %d edges", nrow(g_c)), t3)
    return(g_c)
  }

  # ---- pbf fallback path (no turn penalties) -----------------------------
  pts_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(points_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = CRS_LL)
  bb <- sf::st_bbox(pts_sf)
  bb_buf <- bb + c(-0.05, -0.05, 0.05, 0.05)  # ~5 km buffer
  boundary_poly <- sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(c(
    xmin = bb_buf[["xmin"]], ymin = bb_buf[["ymin"]],
    xmax = bb_buf[["xmax"]], ymax = bb_buf[["ymax"]]),
    crs = CRS_LL))
  log_msg(sprintf("Clipping OSM read to bbox %.4f, %.4f, %.4f, %.4f (5 km buffer)",
                  bb_buf[["xmin"]], bb_buf[["ymin"]],
                  bb_buf[["xmax"]], bb_buf[["ymax"]]))

  log_msg("Reading driving network from pbf via osmextract::oe_read...")
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  drive_tags <- c("highway", "oneway", "maxspeed", "access", "motor_vehicle")
  streetnet_sf <- osmextract::oe_read(
    pbf_files, layer = "lines",
    extra_tags = drive_tags,
    boundary = boundary_poly,
    boundary_type = "spat",
    query = paste(
      "SELECT * FROM lines",
      "WHERE highway IN (",
      "'motorway','trunk','primary','secondary','tertiary',",
      "'unclassified','residential','service',",
      "'motorway_link','trunk_link','primary_link',",
      "'secondary_link','tertiary_link')"),
    quiet = TRUE)
  log_done(sprintf("oe_read drivable network: %d edges",
                   nrow(streetnet_sf)), t1)

  log_msg("Weighting graph (motorcar profile, no turn penalties)...")
  t2 <- Sys.time()
  g <- dodgr::weight_streetnet(streetnet_sf, wt_profile = "motorcar",
                               turn_penalty = FALSE)
  log_msg(sprintf("Raw graph: %d edges", nrow(g)))

  log_msg("Restricting to largest connected component...")
  g <- g[g$component == 1, ]
  log_msg(sprintf("Largest component: %d edges", nrow(g)))

  log_msg("Contracting graph (collapses degree-2 chains)...")
  g_c <- dodgr::dodgr_contract_graph(g)
  log_done(sprintf("contracted graph: %d edges", nrow(g_c)), t2)
  g_c
})

# Count vertices via dodgr's helper rather than column-name introspection —
# turn-penalty contracted graphs use .vx0/.vx1 internally, standard graphs
# use from_id/to_id, and the helper handles both.
.n_dodgr_vertices <- nrow(dodgr::dodgr_vertices(dodgr_graph))
log_msg(sprintf("dodgr graph ready: %d edges, %d vertices",
                nrow(dodgr_graph), .n_dodgr_vertices))
```

# 5. Compute skims

## 5a. Walk skim

```{r skim-walk}
log_stage("Stage 6a: Walk skim (r5r)")

skim_walk <- with_cache("skim_walk",
  list(od = digest::digest(od_pairs),
       points = digest::digest(points_df)),
  function() {
    log_msg(sprintf("Walking %d OD pairs (limit %d min, parallel x %d threads)...",
                    nrow(od_pairs), R5_MAX_WALK_MIN, N_VCPU))
    compute_pairwise_r5_itineraries(
      r5r_network = r5r_network,
      od_pairs = od_pairs, points_df = points_df,
      mode = "WALK", departure_datetime = DEP_ANY,
      label = "Walk skim", time_window = 1L,
      max_walk_time = R5_MAX_WALK_MIN,
      max_trip_duration = R5_MAX_TRIP_MIN
    ) %>%
      transmute(origin_id, dest_id,
                walk_tt_raw  = tt_min,
                walk_dist_mi = dist_m / 1609.344)
  })

log_msg(sprintf("Walk skim: %d pairs, %.1f%% finite",
                nrow(skim_walk),
                100 * mean(is.finite(skim_walk$walk_tt_raw))))
log_msg("Walk time summary (min):")
print(summary(skim_walk$walk_tt_raw))
```
