
## 5c. Transit skim (in-vehicle, wait, walk, n_legs by representative hour)

The 20-minute window with median aggregation absorbs frequency variance
without exposing the model to the "I just missed a bus" tail. We bin trips
by (dow_type, tod_bin) and route each bin once at its representative hour;
trips inherit their bin's skim. r5r's `expanded_travel_time_matrix` with
`breakdown = TRUE` returns per-itinerary access/wait/ride/transfer/egress,
which we sum into the four columns the production model needs.

```{r skim-transit}
log_stage("Stage 6c: Transit skim (r5r, 20-min window, median, breakdown)")

skim_transit <- with_cache("skim_transit",
  list(od = digest::digest(od_pairs),
       points = digest::digest(points_df),
       window = TRANSIT_TIME_WINDOW),
  function() {
    transit_bins <- trips_seattle %>%
      distinct(dow_type, tod_bin, depart_date, depart_hour) %>%
      group_by(dow_type, tod_bin) %>%
      summarise(rep_date = min(depart_date),
                rep_hour = as.integer(round(median(depart_hour))),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(rep_datetime = as.POSIXct(
        paste0(rep_date, " ",
               sprintf("%02d:00:00", pmax(0, pmin(23, rep_hour)))),
        tz = "America/Los_Angeles"))

    bin_counts <- trips_seattle %>%
      distinct(dow_type, tod_bin, origin_id, dest_id) %>%
      group_by(dow_type, tod_bin) %>%
      summarise(n_pairs = n(),
                n_origins = n_distinct(origin_id),
                .groups = "drop")
    transit_bins <- transit_bins %>%
      left_join(bin_counts, by = c("dow_type", "tod_bin")) %>%
      mutate(n_pairs = coalesce(n_pairs, 0L),
             n_origins = coalesce(n_origins, 0L))
    log_msg("Transit bins to route:")
    print(transit_bins %>% select(dow_type, tod_bin, rep_hour, n_origins, n_pairs))

    total_chunks <- sum(pmax(1L, ceiling(transit_bins$n_origins /
                                          TRANSIT_ORIGIN_CHUNK_SIZE)))
    pb <- progress::progress_bar$new(
      format = paste0("Transit skim [:bar] :percent | ",
                      "eta: :eta | :message"),
      total  = total_chunks, clear = FALSE, width = 90)

    transit_list <- vector("list", nrow(transit_bins))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(transit_bins))) {
      b <- transit_bins[i, ]
      od_bin <- trips_seattle %>%
        filter(dow_type == b$dow_type, tod_bin == b$tod_bin) %>%
        distinct(origin_id, dest_id)
      if (nrow(od_bin) == 0) next
      origin_ids <- sort(unique(od_bin$origin_id))
      origin_chunks <- split(
        origin_ids,
        ceiling(seq_along(origin_ids) / TRANSIT_ORIGIN_CHUNK_SIZE))
      dep_dt <- b$rep_datetime - TRANSIT_WINDOW_PRE * 60

      time_out <- vector("list", length(origin_chunks))
      for (k in seq_along(origin_chunks)) {
        o_ids <- origin_chunks[[k]]
        od_sub <- od_bin %>% filter(origin_id %in% o_ids)
        origins_pts <- points_df %>% filter(id %in% unique(od_sub$origin_id))
        dests_pts   <- points_df %>% filter(id %in% unique(od_sub$dest_id))
        if (nrow(origins_pts) > 0 && nrow(dests_pts) > 0) {
          m <- ettm_safe(
            r5r_network = r5r_network,
            origins = origins_pts, destinations = dests_pts,
            mode = c("WALK", "TRANSIT"), mode_egress = "WALK",
            departure_datetime = dep_dt,
            time_window = TRANSIT_TIME_WINDOW,
            breakdown = TRUE,
            max_walk_time = TRANSIT_ROUTING_WALK_MIN,
            max_trip_duration = TRANSIT_ROUTING_TOTAL_MIN,
            max_rides = MAX_TRANSIT_RIDES,
            n_threads = N_VCPU,
            progress = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
          dt_m <- data.table::as.data.table(m)
          if (nrow(dt_m) > 0) {
            time_out[[k]] <- dt_m[, .(
              transit_total_raw    = safe_median(total_time),
              transit_access_raw   = safe_median(access_time),
              transit_wait_raw     = safe_median(wait_time),
              transit_ivtt_raw     = safe_median(ride_time),
              transit_transfer_raw = safe_median(transfer_time),
              transit_egress_raw   = safe_median(egress_time),
              transit_nrides_raw   = safe_median(as.numeric(n_rides))
            ), by = .(from_id, to_id)] %>%
              as_tibble() %>%
              transmute(
                origin_id = from_id, dest_id = to_id,
                transit_total_raw,
                transit_walk_raw = transit_access_raw +
                                   transit_transfer_raw +
                                   transit_egress_raw,
                transit_wait_raw, transit_ivtt_raw, transit_nrides_raw) %>%
              inner_join(od_sub, by = c("origin_id", "dest_id"))
          }
        }
        pb$tick(tokens = list(message = sprintf(
          "%s %s chunk %d/%d", b$dow_type, b$tod_bin, k,
          length(origin_chunks))))
      }

      transit_time_bin <- bind_rows(time_out)
      if (nrow(transit_time_bin) == 0) next

      # Distance in transit network (used as availability sanity check
      # and for diagnostics; the upper-level model uses the time
      # components, not distance).
      dist_chunks <- chunk_indices(nrow(od_bin), R5_PAIR_CHUNK_SIZE)
      dist_out <- vector("list", length(dist_chunks))
      for (k in seq_along(dist_chunks)) {
        od_chunk <- od_bin[dist_chunks[[k]], , drop = FALSE]
        det <- compute_pairwise_r5_itineraries(
          r5r_network = r5r_network, od_pairs = od_chunk,
          points_df = points_df,
          mode = c("WALK", "TRANSIT"), mode_egress = "WALK",
          departure_datetime = b$rep_datetime, label = "(transit-dist)",
          time_window = 1L,
          max_walk_time = TRANSIT_ROUTING_WALK_MIN,
          max_trip_duration = TRANSIT_ROUTING_TOTAL_MIN,
          max_rides = MAX_TRANSIT_RIDES, shortest_path = TRUE,
          chunk_size = nrow(od_chunk))
        dist_out[[k]] <- det %>%
          transmute(origin_id, dest_id,
                    transit_dist_mi = dist_m / 1609.344)
      }
      transit_dist_bin <- bind_rows(dist_out)
      transit_list[[i]] <- transit_time_bin %>%
        left_join(transit_dist_bin, by = c("origin_id", "dest_id")) %>%
        mutate(dow_type = b$dow_type, tod_bin = b$tod_bin)
    }
    bind_rows(transit_list)
  })

log_msg(sprintf("Transit skim: %d (OD,bin) rows, %.1f%% have finite ivtt",
                nrow(skim_transit),
                100 * mean(is.finite(skim_transit$transit_ivtt_raw))))
print(summary(skim_transit %>%
                select(transit_total_raw, transit_walk_raw,
                       transit_wait_raw, transit_ivtt_raw)))
```

## 5d. Drive skim (dodgr primary, r5r fallback for unreachable pairs)

dodgr is fast and supports link-level edits we'll need in Phase 2 for
TSP / bus-lane / AV scenarios. Where dodgr can't find a path (typically
origins/destinations on disconnected graph fragments), we fall back to
r5r's car routing and report the breakdown.

```{r skim-drive}
log_stage("Stage 6d: Drive skim (dodgr + r5r fallback)")

skim_drive <- with_cache("skim_drive",
  list(od = digest::digest(od_pairs),
       points = digest::digest(points_df),
       graph_signature = digest::digest(dodgr_graph),
       version = "v2_knn_retry"),     # bump to invalidate v1 single-vertex caches
  function() {
    # K-nearest-vertex retry: the original 1-vertex-per-centroid snapping
    # produced 36% routing failures (centroids snapping to dead-end /
    # one-way / disconnected sub-region vertices). For each centroid we
    # find the K nearest graph vertices, then for OD pairs that fail
    # routing on the (k=1, k=1) candidate we retry with (k1, k2)
    # combinations until we find a valid route or exhaust K_MAX*K_MAX
    # attempts.
    #
    # Coverage matters MORE than model fit here: every OD pair that falls
    # back to r5r is one we can't manipulate for Phase 2 scenarios
    # (TSP / bus-lane / AV congestion all require link-level edits to the
    # dodgr graph; r5r doesn't expose its edge weights for editing).
    # K=10 gives 100 (k1, k2) combinations to try; later rounds are cheap
    # because they only route still-failing pairs.
    K_MAX <- 10L

    log_msg(sprintf("Mapping centroids to %d nearest dodgr graph vertices each...",
                    K_MAX))
    verts <- dodgr::dodgr_vertices(dodgr_graph)
    verts_xy <- as.matrix(verts[, c("x", "y")])
    points_xy <- as.matrix(points_df[, c("lon", "lat")])
    knn <- FNN::get.knnx(verts_xy, points_xy, k = K_MAX)
    # knn$nn.index is N_centroids × K_MAX matrix of vertex indices
    knn_vert_id <- matrix(verts$id[as.vector(knn$nn.index)],
                          nrow = nrow(knn$nn.index))
    rownames(knn_vert_id) <- points_df$id

    # Helper: get a vertex of choice k for a given tract id.
    knn_vertex <- function(tract_ids, k) {
      idx <- match(tract_ids, rownames(knn_vert_id))
      knn_vert_id[cbind(idx, rep(k, length(tract_ids)))]
    }

    # Check that every tract has its k=1 vertex (sanity).
    miss_k1 <- sum(is.na(knn_vertex(points_df$id, 1)))
    if (miss_k1 > 0) {
      log_msg(sprintf("WARNING: %d centroids didn't get a k=1 vertex match",
                      miss_k1))
    }

    # Initialize result columns.
    out <- od_pairs %>%
      mutate(drive_tt_dodgr = NA_real_,
             drive_dist_dodgr_m = NA_real_,
             snap_k    = NA_integer_,
             o_vertex  = NA_character_,
             d_vertex  = NA_character_)

    # Outer loop: try each (k1, k2) combination, in order of increasing
    # total snap rank. Each round only routes still-NA pairs, and only
    # writes back to those.
    rounds <- expand.grid(k1 = 1:K_MAX, k2 = 1:K_MAX) %>%
      arrange(k1 + k2, k1, k2) %>%
      as_tibble()

    log_msg(sprintf("Routing in %d (k1,k2) rounds with up to %d pairs each",
                    nrow(rounds), nrow(out)))
    pb_rounds <- progress::progress_bar$new(
      format = "dodgr knn-retry [:bar] :percent | round :message",
      total  = nrow(rounds), clear = FALSE, width = 80)

    for (r in seq_len(nrow(rounds))) {
      k1 <- rounds$k1[r]; k2 <- rounds$k2[r]
      still_na <- !is.finite(out$drive_tt_dodgr) | out$drive_tt_dodgr <= 0
      if (!any(still_na)) {
        pb_rounds$tick(tokens = list(message = sprintf(
          "(%d,%d) skipped — all routed", k1, k2)))
        next
      }
      sub <- out[still_na, , drop = FALSE]
      o_vert <- knn_vertex(sub$origin_id, k1)
      d_vert <- knn_vertex(sub$dest_id,   k2)
      ok_input <- !is.na(o_vert) & !is.na(d_vert)
      if (!any(ok_input)) {
        pb_rounds$tick(tokens = list(message = sprintf(
          "(%d,%d) no valid vertex pairs", k1, k2)))
        next
      }
      sub_ok <- sub[ok_input, , drop = FALSE]
      o_v <- o_vert[ok_input]; d_v <- d_vert[ok_input]
      tt_sec <- dodgr_pairwise(dodgr_graph, o_v, d_v,
                               fun = dodgr::dodgr_times)
      dd_m   <- dodgr_pairwise(dodgr_graph, o_v, d_v,
                               fun = dodgr::dodgr_dists)

      ok_route <- is.finite(tt_sec) & tt_sec > 0 &
                  is.finite(dd_m)   & dd_m > 0
      if (any(ok_route)) {
        # Map back to row indices in `out`
        still_na_idx <- which(still_na)
        sub_idx <- still_na_idx[ok_input][ok_route]
        out$drive_tt_dodgr[sub_idx]     <- tt_sec[ok_route] / 60
        out$drive_dist_dodgr_m[sub_idx] <- dd_m[ok_route]
        out$snap_k[sub_idx]             <- k1 * 10L + k2  # encode k1k2 for diagnostics
        out$o_vertex[sub_idx] <- o_v[ok_route]
        out$d_vertex[sub_idx] <- d_v[ok_route]
      }
      pb_rounds$tick(tokens = list(message = sprintf(
        "(%d,%d): +%d / %d still NA",
        k1, k2, sum(ok_route), sum(still_na) - sum(ok_route))))
    }

    # Diagnostic: how many pairs were resolved at each (k1,k2) tier?
    log_msg(sprintf("dodgr success after K=%d retry: %d / %d pairs (%.1f%%)",
                    K_MAX, sum(is.finite(out$drive_tt_dodgr)),
                    nrow(out), 100 * mean(is.finite(out$drive_tt_dodgr))))
    log_msg("dodgr success counts by (k1, k2) snap tier:")
    snap_summary <- out %>%
      filter(is.finite(drive_tt_dodgr)) %>%
      mutate(k1 = snap_k %/% 10L, k2 = snap_k %% 10L) %>%
      count(k1, k2)
    print(snap_summary)

    # Radial-expansion last resort: for pairs still NA after K-NN, take
    # ALL graph vertices within a generous radius of each centroid
    # (ignoring the K limit) and try every combination. This is slow but
    # we only do it for the residual unrouted pairs.
    still_unrouted <- !is.finite(out$drive_tt_dodgr) | out$drive_tt_dodgr <= 0
    if (any(still_unrouted)) {
      n_still <- sum(still_unrouted)
      log_msg(sprintf("Radial-expansion retry for %d still-unrouted pairs...",
                      n_still))
      RADIAL_M <- 1500   # 1.5 km — generous but not silly
      MAX_VERTS <- 25L   # cap per side to bound combinatorics

      radial_unique_tracts <- unique(c(out$origin_id[still_unrouted],
                                       out$dest_id[still_unrouted]))
      tract_xy <- points_df %>% filter(id %in% radial_unique_tracts)
      # Find all vertices within RADIAL_M meters (rough — using degrees)
      radial_deg <- RADIAL_M / 111000
      vert_neighbors <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(tract_xy)), function(i) {
        dx <- verts_xy[, 1] - tract_xy$lon[i]
        dy <- verts_xy[, 2] - tract_xy$lat[i]
        # Quick bbox filter then exact distance
        bb <- abs(dx) <= radial_deg & abs(dy) <= radial_deg
        idx_bb <- which(bb)
        if (length(idx_bb) == 0) return(integer())
        d_m <- sqrt((dx[idx_bb] * 111000)^2 + (dy[idx_bb] * 111000 *
                                               cos(tract_xy$lat[i] * pi/180))^2)
        keep <- d_m <= RADIAL_M
        v_idx <- idx_bb[keep]
        if (length(v_idx) > MAX_VERTS) {
          v_idx <- v_idx[order(d_m[keep])][seq_len(MAX_VERTS)]
        }
        v_idx
      })
      names(vert_neighbors) <- tract_xy$id

      pb_radial <- progress::progress_bar$new(
        format = "radial retry [:bar] :percent | :message",
        total  = n_still, clear = FALSE, width = 80)
      still_idx <- which(still_unrouted)
      n_recovered <- 0L
      for (i in still_idx) {
        o_id <- out$origin_id[i]; d_id <- out$dest_id[i]
        o_neighbors <- vert_neighbors[[o_id]]
        d_neighbors <- vert_neighbors[[d_id]]
        if (length(o_neighbors) == 0 || length(d_neighbors) == 0) {
          pb_radial$tick(tokens = list(message = "no neighbors"))
          next
        }
        o_v_set <- verts$id[o_neighbors]
        d_v_set <- verts$id[d_neighbors]
        # Try the matrix lookup (unique-from x unique-to)
        mat_t <- tryCatch(
          dodgr::dodgr_times(graph = dodgr_graph,
                             from = o_v_set, to = d_v_set,
                             shortest = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL)
        mat_d <- tryCatch(
          dodgr::dodgr_dists(graph = dodgr_graph,
                             from = o_v_set, to = d_v_set,
                             shortest = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(mat_t) || is.null(mat_d)) {
          pb_radial$tick(tokens = list(message = "dodgr error"))
          next
        }
        # Pick the (origin_v, dest_v) cell with the minimum finite time
        finite_cells <- which(is.finite(mat_t) & mat_t > 0 &
                              is.finite(mat_d) & mat_d > 0)
        if (length(finite_cells) == 0) {
          pb_radial$tick(tokens = list(message = "no finite route"))
          next
        }
        best <- finite_cells[which.min(mat_t[finite_cells])]
        out$drive_tt_dodgr[i]     <- mat_t[best] / 60
        out$drive_dist_dodgr_m[i] <- mat_d[best]
        out$snap_k[i]             <- 99L  # marker for "radial fallback"
        row_idx <- ((best - 1L) %% nrow(mat_t)) + 1L
        col_idx <- ((best - 1L) %/% nrow(mat_t)) + 1L
        out$o_vertex[i] <- o_v_set[row_idx]
        out$d_vertex[i] <- d_v_set[col_idx]
        n_recovered <- n_recovered + 1L
        pb_radial$tick(tokens = list(message = sprintf("recovered %d", n_recovered)))
      }
      log_msg(sprintf("Radial retry recovered %d / %d pairs",
                      n_recovered, n_still))
    }

    n_dodgr_total <- sum(is.finite(out$drive_tt_dodgr))
    log_msg(sprintf("dodgr success FINAL: %d / %d pairs (%.1f%%)",
                    n_dodgr_total, nrow(out),
                    100 * n_dodgr_total / nrow(out)))

    # r5r fallback for whatever's still unrouted (these will not be
    # manipulable for Phase 2 link-level scenarios; tracked separately).
    od_fail <- out %>%
      filter(!is.finite(drive_tt_dodgr) | drive_tt_dodgr <= 0) %>%
      distinct(origin_id, dest_id)
    if (nrow(od_fail) > 0) {
      log_msg(sprintf("Phase-2 NON-MANIPULABLE: %d pairs falling back to r5r CAR\n",
                      nrow(od_fail)))
      car_r5r <- compute_pairwise_r5_itineraries(
        r5r_network = r5r_network, od_pairs = od_fail,
        points_df = points_df, mode = "CAR",
        departure_datetime = DEP_ANY, label = "r5r drive fallback",
        time_window = 1L, max_car_time = R5_MAX_CAR_MIN,
        max_trip_duration = R5_MAX_TRIP_MIN) %>%
        transmute(origin_id, dest_id,
                  drive_tt_r5r = tt_min,
                  drive_dist_r5r_m = dist_m)
    } else {
      car_r5r <- tibble(origin_id = character(), dest_id = character(),
                        drive_tt_r5r = numeric(),
                        drive_dist_r5r_m = numeric())
    }

    final <- out %>%
      left_join(car_r5r, by = c("origin_id", "dest_id")) %>%
      mutate(
        drive_tt_raw   = coalesce(drive_tt_dodgr, drive_tt_r5r),
        drive_dist_mi  = coalesce(drive_dist_dodgr_m,
                                  drive_dist_r5r_m) / 1609.344,
        drive_source   = case_when(
          is.finite(drive_tt_dodgr) & drive_tt_dodgr > 0 ~ "dodgr",
          is.finite(drive_tt_r5r)   & drive_tt_r5r > 0   ~ "r5r_fallback",
          TRUE                                            ~ NA_character_)
      ) %>%
      select(origin_id, dest_id, drive_tt_raw, drive_dist_mi, drive_source, o_vertex, d_vertex, snap_k)

    log_msg("Final drive skim provenance breakdown:")
    print(final %>% count(drive_source))
    final
  })

log_msg(sprintf("Drive skim final: %d pairs, %.1f%% finite",
                nrow(skim_drive),
                100 * mean(is.finite(skim_drive$drive_tt_raw))))
log_msg("Drive provenance:")
print(skim_drive %>% count(drive_source))
print(summary(skim_drive$drive_tt_raw))
```

# 6. Join skims to trips and compute availability

```{r join-skims}
log_stage("Stage 7: Join skims to trips + compute alternative availability")

trips_skim <- trips_seattle %>%
  left_join(skim_walk,    by = c("origin_id", "dest_id")) %>%
  left_join(skim_bike,    by = c("origin_id", "dest_id")) %>%
  left_join(skim_drive,   by = c("origin_id", "dest_id")) %>%
  left_join(skim_transit, by = c("origin_id", "dest_id",
                                 "dow_type", "tod_bin")) %>%
  mutate(
    walk_avail = is.finite(walk_tt_raw) & walk_tt_raw > 0 &
                 is.finite(walk_dist_mi) & walk_dist_mi > 0,
    bike_avail = is.finite(bike_tt_raw) & bike_tt_raw > 0 &
                 is.finite(bike_dist_mi) & bike_dist_mi > 0,
    drive_avail = is.finite(drive_tt_raw) & drive_tt_raw > 0 &
                  is.finite(drive_dist_mi) & drive_dist_mi > 0,
    transit_avail =
      is.finite(transit_total_raw) & transit_total_raw > 0 &
      is.finite(transit_dist_mi)   & transit_dist_mi > 0 &
      is.finite(transit_walk_raw)  & transit_walk_raw <= MAX_TRANSIT_WALK_MIN &
      is.finite(transit_wait_raw)  & transit_wait_raw <= MAX_TRANSIT_WAIT_MIN &
      is.finite(transit_total_raw) & transit_total_raw <= MAX_TRANSIT_TOTAL_MIN &
      (is.na(transit_nrides_raw) |
         transit_nrides_raw <= MAX_TRANSIT_RIDES)
  )

log_msg("Per-mode availability among intra-Seattle trips:")
print(trips_skim %>%
        summarise(walk = mean(walk_avail), bike = mean(bike_avail),
                  drive = mean(drive_avail), transit = mean(transit_avail)))
log_msg("Joint availability (number of available alts per trip):")
print(trips_skim %>%
        mutate(n_avail = walk_avail + bike_avail + drive_avail + transit_avail) %>%
        count(n_avail))
```

# 7. Drive-time GAM calibration

GAM regresses log(observed/predicted) on log(distance) + TOD + DOW with
peer log-ratios from same-OD-pair / TOD / DOW trips. The fitted ratio is
then applied to dodgr's free-flow drive time to produce `drive_tt_cal`.

```{r calibrate-drive}
log_stage("Stage 8: Drive-time GAM calibration")

make_drive_calibration_frame <- function(df) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(mode_norm == "drive", drive_avail,
           is.finite(duration_minutes), duration_minutes > 0,
           is.finite(drive_tt_raw),  drive_tt_raw > 0,
           is.finite(drive_dist_mi), drive_dist_mi > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      pred_time   = drive_tt_raw,
      obs_time    = duration_minutes,
      obs_dist_mi = pmax(distance_miles, MIN_POSITIVE_MI),
      pred_dist_mi= pmax(drive_dist_mi, MIN_POSITIVE_MI),
      log_ratio   = log(obs_time / pred_time),
      w           = 1
    )
  grp <- d %>%
    group_by(origin_id, dest_id, tod_bin, dow_type) %>%
    summarise(sw = sum(w), swlr = sum(w * log_ratio), .groups = "drop")
  td <- d %>%
    group_by(tod_bin, dow_type) %>%
    summarise(td_peer = weighted_mean_safe(log_ratio, w), .groups = "drop")
  global_peer <- weighted_mean_safe(d$log_ratio, d$w)
  d %>%
    left_join(grp, by = c("origin_id", "dest_id", "tod_bin", "dow_type")) %>%
    left_join(td,  by = c("tod_bin", "dow_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      peer_log_ratio = if_else(sw > w, (swlr - w * log_ratio) /
                               (sw - w), NA_real_),
      peer_log_ratio = coalesce(peer_log_ratio, td_peer, global_peer),
      log_obs_dist   = log(obs_dist_mi),
      log_pred_dist  = log(pred_dist_mi)
    )
}

cal_drive_df <- make_drive_calibration_frame(trips_skim)
log_msg(sprintf("Calibration frame: %d drive trips with valid pred & obs",
                nrow(cal_drive_df)))

cal_drive_model <- with_cache("drive_gam",
  list(rows = nrow(cal_drive_df),
       digest = digest::digest(cal_drive_df %>%
                                  select(log_ratio, log_obs_dist,
                                         log_pred_dist, peer_log_ratio,
                                         tod_bin, dow_type))),
  function() {
    log_msg("Fitting GAM (REML) for drive time calibration...")
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    m <- tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(
        log_ratio ~ s(log_obs_dist, k = 10) + s(log_pred_dist, k = 10) +
                    ti(log_obs_dist, log_pred_dist, k = c(6, 6)) +
                    s(peer_log_ratio, k = 8) + tod_bin + dow_type,
        data = cal_drive_df, weights = w, method = "REML",
        control = mgcv::gam.control(nthreads = min(N_VCPU, 8L))),
      error = function(e) {
        log_msg(sprintf("Full GAM failed (%s); falling back to simpler form",
                        conditionMessage(e)))
        mgcv::gam(
          log_ratio ~ s(log_obs_dist, k = 10) + s(log_pred_dist, k = 10) +
                      s(peer_log_ratio, k = 8) + tod_bin + dow_type,
          data = cal_drive_df, weights = w, method = "REML",
          control = mgcv::gam.control(nthreads = min(N_VCPU, 8L)))
      })
    log_done("GAM fit", t0)
    m
  })

log_msg("GAM summary:")
print(summary(cal_drive_model))

# Peer-lookup tables for application to all trips (calibration frame is
# only the drive trips; we apply to every trip's drive_tt_raw).
peer_drive <- list(
  od = cal_drive_df %>%
    group_by(origin_id, dest_id, tod_bin, dow_type) %>%
    summarise(peer_log_ratio = weighted_mean_safe(log_ratio, w),
              .groups = "drop"),
  td = cal_drive_df %>%
    group_by(tod_bin, dow_type) %>%
    summarise(td_peer = weighted_mean_safe(log_ratio, w),
              .groups = "drop"),
  global = weighted_mean_safe(cal_drive_df$log_ratio, cal_drive_df$w))

apply_drive_calibration <- function(df) {
  nd <- df %>%
    mutate(pred_time = drive_tt_raw,
           obs_dist_mi = pmax(distance_miles, MIN_POSITIVE_MI),
           pred_dist_mi = pmax(drive_dist_mi, MIN_POSITIVE_MI)) %>%
    left_join(peer_drive$od,
              by = c("origin_id", "dest_id", "tod_bin", "dow_type")) %>%
    left_join(peer_drive$td, by = c("tod_bin", "dow_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      peer_log_ratio = coalesce(peer_log_ratio, td_peer, peer_drive$global),
      log_obs_dist   = log(obs_dist_mi),
      log_pred_dist  = log(pred_dist_mi))
  ok <- nd$drive_avail &
        is.finite(nd$pred_time) & nd$pred_time > 0 &
        is.finite(nd$pred_dist_mi) & nd$pred_dist_mi > 0 &
        is.finite(nd$log_obs_dist) & is.finite(nd$log_pred_dist) &
        is.finite(nd$peer_log_ratio)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(nd))
  if (any(ok)) {
    out[ok] <- nd$pred_time[ok] *
               exp(predict(cal_drive_model, newdata = nd[ok, ],
                           type = "response"))
  }
  out
}

trips_cal <- trips_skim %>%
  mutate(drive_tt_cal = apply_drive_calibration(.))

log_msg(sprintf("drive_tt_cal computed for %.1f%% of trips with drive_avail",
                100 * mean(is.finite(trips_cal$drive_tt_cal[trips_cal$drive_avail]))))
log_msg("Drive time before vs after calibration (median ratio):")
print(trips_cal %>%
        filter(drive_avail) %>%
        summarise(
          median_raw = median(drive_tt_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_cal = median(drive_tt_cal, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio      = median_cal / median_raw))
```

# 8. Intra-tract trip handling

15% of trips have origin tract == destination tract. They have no useful
skim (centroid-to-centroid distance is zero), so we mock travel time from
the trip's actual reported distance plus mode-specific average speeds in
the same TOD × DOW bin from inter-tract trips. A floor of half-tract-radius
prevents pathological zeros.

```{r intratract}
log_stage("Stage 9: Intra-tract trip handling")

speed_refs <- trips_cal %>%
  filter(origin_id != dest_id) %>%
  transmute(tod_bin, dow_type, obs_dist = distance_miles,
            spd_walk  = if_else(is.finite(walk_tt_raw)  & walk_tt_raw  > 0,
                                obs_dist / (walk_tt_raw / 60),  NA_real_),
            spd_bike  = if_else(is.finite(bike_tt_raw)  & bike_tt_raw  > 0,
                                obs_dist / (bike_tt_raw / 60),  NA_real_),
            spd_drive = if_else(is.finite(drive_tt_cal) & drive_tt_cal > 0,
                                obs_dist / (drive_tt_cal / 60), NA_real_),
            spd_transit = if_else(is.finite(transit_total_raw) & transit_total_raw > 0,
                                obs_dist / (transit_total_raw / 60), NA_real_)) %>%
  group_by(tod_bin, dow_type) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("spd_"),
                   ~ median(.x[is.finite(.x)], na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

# Tract area (sq mi) for the half-radius floor.
tract_area_lookup <- tracts_sf %>%
  st_transform(CRS_PLANAR) %>%
  mutate(tract_area_sqmi = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 27878400) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(GEOID, tract_area_sqmi)

# Transit component shares for distributing transit_total_mock across
# walk / wait / ivtt.
transit_shares <- trips_cal %>%
  filter(is.finite(transit_total_raw), transit_total_raw > 0) %>%
  mutate(s_walk = transit_walk_raw / transit_total_raw,
         s_wait = transit_wait_raw / transit_total_raw,
         s_ivtt = transit_ivtt_raw / transit_total_raw) %>%
  group_by(tod_bin, dow_type) %>%
  summarise(s_walk = median(s_walk[is.finite(s_walk)], na.rm = TRUE),
            s_wait = median(s_wait[is.finite(s_wait)], na.rm = TRUE),
            s_ivtt = median(s_ivtt[is.finite(s_ivtt)], na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

trips_cal <- trips_cal %>%
  left_join(tract_area_lookup,
            by = c("origin_id" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename(origin_tract_area_sqmi = tract_area_sqmi) %>%
  left_join(tract_area_lookup,
            by = c("dest_id" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename(dest_tract_area_sqmi = tract_area_sqmi) %>%
  left_join(speed_refs,    by = c("tod_bin", "dow_type")) %>%
  left_join(transit_shares, by = c("tod_bin", "dow_type")) %>%
  mutate(
    intratract = origin_id == dest_id,
    intratract_dist_mi = pmax(
      distance_miles,
      sqrt(pmax(origin_tract_area_sqmi, dest_tract_area_sqmi,
                na.rm = TRUE) / pi) * 0.5),
    walk_dist_mock_mi    = intratract_dist_mi * 1.15,
    bike_dist_mock_mi    = intratract_dist_mi * 1.10,
    drive_dist_mock_mi   = intratract_dist_mi * 1.25,
    transit_dist_mock_mi = intratract_dist_mi * 1.25,
    walk_tt_mock         = walk_dist_mock_mi / spd_walk * 60,
    bike_tt_mock         = bike_dist_mock_mi / spd_bike * 60,
    drive_tt_mock        = drive_dist_mock_mi / spd_drive * 60,
    transit_tt_mock      = transit_dist_mock_mi / spd_transit * 60
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    walk_avail  = if_else(intratract, TRUE, walk_avail),
    bike_avail  = if_else(intratract, TRUE, bike_avail),
    drive_avail = if_else(intratract, TRUE, drive_avail)
    # transit_avail intentionally NOT set true: intra-tract transit
    # rarely makes sense (you'd just walk).
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    walk_tt_raw  = if_else(intratract & walk_avail  &
                           (!is.finite(walk_tt_raw)  | walk_tt_raw  <= 0),
                           walk_tt_mock, walk_tt_raw),
    bike_tt_raw  = if_else(intratract & bike_avail  &
                           (!is.finite(bike_tt_raw)  | bike_tt_raw  <= 0),
                           bike_tt_mock, bike_tt_raw),
    drive_tt_cal = if_else(intratract & drive_avail &
                           (!is.finite(drive_tt_cal) | drive_tt_cal <= 0),
                           drive_tt_mock, drive_tt_cal),
    walk_dist_mi   = if_else(intratract & walk_avail  &
                             (!is.finite(walk_dist_mi) | walk_dist_mi <= 0),
                             walk_dist_mock_mi, walk_dist_mi),
    bike_dist_mi   = if_else(intratract & bike_avail  &
                             (!is.finite(bike_dist_mi) | bike_dist_mi <= 0),
                             bike_dist_mock_mi, bike_dist_mi),
    drive_dist_mi  = if_else(intratract & drive_avail &
                             (!is.finite(drive_dist_mi) | drive_dist_mi <= 0),
                             drive_dist_mock_mi, drive_dist_mi),
    transit_dist_mi = if_else(intratract & transit_avail &
                              (!is.finite(transit_dist_mi) | transit_dist_mi <= 0),
                              transit_dist_mock_mi, transit_dist_mi)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    s_walk = coalesce(s_walk, 0.25),
    s_wait = coalesce(s_wait, 0.20),
    s_ivtt = coalesce(s_ivtt, 0.55),
    s_sum  = s_walk + s_wait + s_ivtt,
    s_walk = s_walk / s_sum, s_wait = s_wait / s_sum,
    s_ivtt = s_ivtt / s_sum,
    transit_total_raw = if_else(
      intratract & transit_avail &
        (!is.finite(transit_total_raw) | transit_total_raw <= 0),
      transit_tt_mock, transit_total_raw),
    transit_walk_raw = if_else(
      intratract & transit_avail &
        (!is.finite(transit_walk_raw) | transit_walk_raw < 0),
      transit_tt_mock * s_walk, transit_walk_raw),
    transit_wait_raw = if_else(
      intratract & transit_avail &
        (!is.finite(transit_wait_raw) | transit_wait_raw < 0),
      transit_tt_mock * s_wait, transit_wait_raw),
    transit_ivtt_raw = if_else(
      intratract & transit_avail &
        (!is.finite(transit_ivtt_raw) | transit_ivtt_raw < 0),
      transit_tt_mock * s_ivtt, transit_ivtt_raw)
  ) %>%
  select(-starts_with("spd_"), -ends_with("_mock"),
         -s_walk, -s_wait, -s_ivtt, -s_sum)

log_msg(sprintf("Intra-tract trips: %d (%.1f%% of intra-Seattle)",
                sum(trips_cal$intratract),
                100 * mean(trips_cal$intratract)))
log_msg("Mock-fill summary for intra-tract trips:")
print(trips_cal %>%
        filter(intratract) %>%
        summarise(
          walk_avail = mean(walk_avail),
          bike_avail = mean(bike_avail),
          drive_avail = mean(drive_avail),
          median_walk_tt = median(walk_tt_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_bike_tt = median(bike_tt_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_drive_tt= median(drive_tt_cal, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

## 8b. Snapshot calibration objects for `ThesisFigures.Rmd` (Figures 3-5)

`trips_skim` / `trips_cal` are built in-place and were never written to disk,
so the calibration-figure sidecar could only run inside a live pipeline
session. Snapshot them (and the GAM) under stable names so the sidecar can
knit standalone. `trips_cal` is snapshotted *here* — post mock-fill, before
the parking/fare columns it doesn't need.

```{r calviz-snapshot}
saveRDS(trips_skim,      file.path(CACHE_DIR, "calviz_trips_skim.rds"))
saveRDS(trips_cal,       file.path(CACHE_DIR, "calviz_trips_cal.rds"))
saveRDS(cal_drive_model, file.path(CACHE_DIR, "calviz_drive_gam.rds"))
log_msg(sprintf("Calibration-viz snapshot written to %s (calviz_*.rds)",
                CACHE_DIR))
```

# 9. Parking impedance (logsum across paid-curb / garage / free)

Pulls SDOT layers (paid-parking tiers, RPZ, public garages, and the blockface
inventory for per-segment time limits), computes per-destination-tract
attributes (paid rates by TOD, RPZ coverage, garage proximity, paid-curb time
limit), then builds a per-trip candidate set and aggregates to
`parking_money_usd` (expected money component) plus `parking_search_min`,
`parking_walk_min`, and `parking_restriction_min` (expected re-park time). The
upper-level MNL only uses `parking_money_usd` (folded into `cost`), but the time
components are saved for sensitivity analysis in Phase 2.

```{r parking}
log_stage("Stage 10: Parking impedance from SDOT layers")

# 10a. Fetch and cache layers ---------------------------------------------
parking_tiers_sf <- with_cache("parking_tiers_sf",
  list(url = params$parking_tiers_url),
  function() {
    log_msg("Fetching SDOT paid-parking tiers...")
    sf::st_read(params$parking_tiers_url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL) %>% st_make_valid()
  })
log_msg(sprintf("Parking tier polygons: %d (cols: %s)",
                nrow(parking_tiers_sf),
                paste(setdiff(names(parking_tiers_sf), "geometry"),
                      collapse = ", ")))

rpz_sf <- with_cache("rpz_sf",
  list(url = params$parking_rpz_url),
  function() {
    log_msg("Fetching SDOT RPZ polygons...")
    sf::st_read(params$parking_rpz_url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL) %>% st_make_valid()
  })
log_msg(sprintf("RPZ polygons: %d", nrow(rpz_sf)))

garages_sf <- with_cache("garages_sf",
  list(url = params$parking_garages_url),
  function() {
    log_msg("Fetching SDOT public garages and lots...")
    sf::st_read(params$parking_garages_url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL) %>% st_make_valid()
  })
log_msg(sprintf("Garage points: %d (cols: %s)",
                nrow(garages_sf),
                paste(head(setdiff(names(garages_sf), "geometry"), 10),
                      collapse = ", ")))

# Parse the garage rate schedule. The layer carries duration-tiered TOTAL
# prices (RTE_1HR/2HR/3HR/ALLDAY) -- totals for a stay of that length, not a
# $/hr rate. "Permit only"/blank mark non-public or unpriced garages.
col_or_na <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(garages_sf)) garages_sf[[nm]] else NA
parse_rate <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(x)))
  if_else(is.finite(v) & v >= 0.5 & v <= 80, v, NA_real_)
}
garages_sf$rte_1hr    <- parse_rate(col_or_na("RTE_1HR"))
garages_sf$rte_2hr    <- parse_rate(col_or_na("RTE_2HR"))
garages_sf$rte_3hr    <- parse_rate(col_or_na("RTE_3HR"))
garages_sf$rte_allday <- parse_rate(col_or_na("RTE_ALLDAY"))
permit_kw <- "PERMIT|LEASE|TENANT|RESERVED|MONTHLY"
garages_sf$is_permit_only <- str_detect(
  toupper(paste(coalesce(as.character(col_or_na("RTE_1HR")),    ""),
                coalesce(as.character(col_or_na("RTE_ALLDAY")), ""))),
  permit_kw)
log_msg(sprintf("Garage rates: %d of %d priced, %d permit-only",
                sum(is.finite(garages_sf$rte_1hr) | is.finite(garages_sf$rte_allday)),
                nrow(garages_sf), sum(garages_sf$is_permit_only)))

# Blockface inventory: per-segment PARKING_TIME_LIMIT (minutes) + paid flag.
blockface_sf <- with_cache("blockface_sf",
  list(url = params$parking_blockface_url),
  function() {
    log_msg("Fetching SDOT blockface inventory (paged)...")
    read_arcgis_paged(params$parking_blockface_url) %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL) %>% st_make_valid()
  })
log_msg(sprintf("Blockface segments: %d (%d paid, %d with a time limit)",
                nrow(blockface_sf),
                sum(coalesce(as.numeric(blockface_sf$PAID_SPACES), 0) > 0),
                sum(is.finite(suppressWarnings(
                  as.numeric(blockface_sf$PARKING_TIME_LIMIT))))))

# NMA neighborhoods: the Downtown district polygon (L_HOOD == "Downtown").
nhoods_sf <- with_cache("nhoods_sf",
  list(url = params$parking_nhoods_url),
  function() {
    log_msg("Fetching NMA neighborhoods...")
    sf::st_read(params$parking_nhoods_url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_transform(CRS_LL) %>% st_make_valid()
  })
log_msg(sprintf("Neighborhood polygons: %d (%d in Downtown district)",
                nrow(nhoods_sf),
                sum(coalesce(nhoods_sf$L_HOOD == "Downtown", FALSE))))

# 10b. Per-destination attributes -----------------------------------------
PLANAR <- CRS_PLANAR
dest_ids <- unique(trips_cal$dest_id)
dest_tracts_sf <- tracts_sf %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% dest_ids) %>%
  rename(dest_id = GEOID) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>% st_transform(PLANAR)

# Area-weighted intersection of paid-tier polygons with each destination tract.
tier_int <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(
  dest_tracts_sf,
  parking_tiers_sf %>% st_transform(PLANAR) %>%
    select(any_of(c("MORNING_RATE", "DAY_RATE", "EVENING_RATE")))
)) %>%
  mutate(a = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

rate_num_safe <- function(x) coalesce(readr::parse_number(as.character(x)), 0)

if (nrow(tier_int) > 0) {
  tiers_by_dest <- tier_int %>%
    mutate(MORNING_RATE = rate_num_safe(MORNING_RATE),
           DAY_RATE     = rate_num_safe(DAY_RATE),
           EVENING_RATE = rate_num_safe(EVENING_RATE)) %>%
    group_by(dest_id) %>%
    summarise(
      covered_area = sum(a, na.rm = TRUE),
      rate_morning = if_else(covered_area > 0,
        sum(a * MORNING_RATE, na.rm = TRUE) / covered_area, 0),
      rate_day     = if_else(covered_area > 0,
        sum(a * DAY_RATE,     na.rm = TRUE) / covered_area, 0),
      rate_evening = if_else(covered_area > 0,
        sum(a * EVENING_RATE, na.rm = TRUE) / covered_area, 0),
      .groups = "drop")
} else {
  tiers_by_dest <- tibble(dest_id = character(), covered_area = numeric(),
                          rate_morning = numeric(), rate_day = numeric(),
                          rate_evening = numeric())
}

dest_attrs <- dest_tracts_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(dest_id) %>%
  left_join(tiers_by_dest, by = "dest_id") %>%
  mutate(across(c(rate_morning, rate_day, rate_evening, covered_area),
                ~ coalesce(.x, 0)))

# RPZ coverage and tract area (for paid_share / unpaid_share).
rpz_planar <- rpz_sf %>% st_transform(PLANAR) %>% st_make_valid()
dest_attrs$dest_rpz <- as.integer(
  lengths(st_intersects(dest_tracts_sf, rpz_planar)) > 0)

rpz_int <- suppressWarnings(
  st_intersection(dest_tracts_sf, rpz_planar)) %>%
  mutate(a = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% st_drop_geometry()
rpz_by_dest <- if (nrow(rpz_int) > 0) {
  rpz_int %>% group_by(dest_id) %>%
    summarise(rpz_area = sum(a, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
} else tibble(dest_id = character(), rpz_area = numeric())

tract_area_lookup_planar <- tibble(
  dest_id = dest_tracts_sf$dest_id,
  tract_area = as.numeric(st_area(dest_tracts_sf)))

dest_attrs <- dest_attrs %>%
  left_join(tract_area_lookup_planar, by = "dest_id") %>%
  left_join(rpz_by_dest, by = "dest_id") %>%
  mutate(
    rpz_area = coalesce(rpz_area, 0),
    paid_share_of_dest = pmin(1, covered_area / tract_area),
    rpz_share_of_dest  = pmin(1, rpz_area / tract_area),
    restricted_share = pmin(1, paid_share_of_dest + rpz_share_of_dest),
    unpaid_share = pmax(0, 1 - restricted_share))

# Downtown classification from the NMA neighborhoods layer (L_HOOD == "Downtown",
# shown as "District" in the portal). Replaces the CBD-distance heuristic.
dest_centroids <- st_centroid(dest_tracts_sf)
downtown_poly  <- nhoods_sf %>% filter(L_HOOD == "Downtown") %>%
  st_transform(PLANAR) %>% st_union()
dest_attrs <- dest_attrs %>%
  left_join(tibble(
    dest_id     = dest_centroids$dest_id,
    is_downtown = lengths(st_intersects(dest_centroids, downtown_poly)) > 0),
    by = "dest_id") %>%
  mutate(area_type = if_else(is_downtown, "downtown", "non_downtown"))

log_msg("Destination tract downtown classification:")
print(dest_attrs %>% count(area_type))

# --- Garage candidate rate: tract-level blend, 3-tier cascade --------------
# 1: dwell-priced blended schedule of priced garages *in the tract*.
# 2: blended curb+garage $/hr over tracts within 0.5 mi.
# 3: blended curb+garage $/hr over the downtown / non-downtown group.
# (4: a fixed $/hr backstop, rarely reached.) Walk distance uses the nearest
# non-permit garage.
garages_planar <- garages_sf %>% st_transform(PLANAR)
garages_public <- garages_planar %>% filter(!coalesce(is_permit_only, FALSE))
garages_priced <- garages_public %>% filter(is.finite(rte_1hr) | is.finite(rte_allday))
nan_na <- function(x) if_else(is.nan(x), NA_real_, x)

# Walk distance: nearest non-permit garage to the tract centroid.
garage_dist_m <- if (nrow(garages_public) > 0) {
  ni <- st_nearest_feature(dest_centroids, garages_public)
  as.numeric(st_distance(dest_centroids, garages_public[ni, ], by_element = TRUE))
} else rep(NA_real_, nrow(dest_centroids))

# Tier 1: blended tier schedule of priced garages whose point is in the tract.
in_tract <- if (nrow(garages_priced) > 0) {
  garages_priced %>% select(rte_1hr, rte_2hr, rte_3hr, rte_allday) %>%
    st_join(dest_tracts_sf %>% select(dest_id), join = st_within) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!is.na(dest_id)) %>%
    group_by(dest_id) %>%
    summarise(tg_r1   = nan_na(mean(rte_1hr,    na.rm = TRUE)),
              tg_r2   = nan_na(mean(rte_2hr,    na.rm = TRUE)),
              tg_r3   = nan_na(mean(rte_3hr,    na.rm = TRUE)),
              tg_rall = nan_na(mean(rte_allday, na.rm = TRUE)),
              .groups = "drop")
} else tibble(dest_id = character(), tg_r1 = numeric(), tg_r2 = numeric(),
              tg_r3 = numeric(), tg_rall = numeric())

dest_attrs <- dest_attrs %>%
  left_join(tibble(dest_id = dest_centroids$dest_id, garage_dist_m = garage_dist_m),
            by = "dest_id") %>%
  left_join(in_tract, by = "dest_id") %>%
  mutate(curb_sig = if_else(rate_day > 0, rate_day, NA_real_),
         park_signal_hr = nan_na(rowMeans(cbind(curb_sig, tg_r1), na.rm = TRUE)))

# Tier 2: mean signal over tracts within 0.5 mi (boundary-to-boundary).
sig <- dest_attrs$park_signal_hr[match(dest_tracts_sf$dest_id, dest_attrs$dest_id)]
nbr_idx <- st_is_within_distance(dest_tracts_sf, dest_tracts_sf,
                                 dist = PARK_MAX_CANDIDATE_M)
blend_halfmi <- vapply(nbr_idx, function(ix) {
  s <- sig[ix]; if (all(is.na(s))) NA_real_ else mean(s, na.rm = TRUE)
}, numeric(1))

# Tier 3: mean signal over the downtown / non-downtown group; tier 4 backstop.
dest_attrs <- dest_attrs %>%
  left_join(tibble(dest_id = dest_tracts_sf$dest_id, blend_halfmi = blend_halfmi),
            by = "dest_id") %>%
  group_by(area_type) %>%
  mutate(blend_group = nan_na(mean(park_signal_hr, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(garage_default_hr = vapply(area_type,
           function(a) PARK_GARAGE_DEFAULT_USD_PER_HR[[a]], numeric(1)))

log_msg("Garage rate provenance:")
print(dest_attrs %>%
        mutate(provenance = case_when(
          is.finite(tg_r1) | is.finite(tg_rall) ~ "1_in_tract_garages",
          is.finite(blend_halfmi)               ~ "2_blend_within_half_mi",
          is.finite(blend_group)                ~ "3_blend_downtown_group",
          TRUE                                  ~ "4_hardcoded_default"
        )) %>%
        count(area_type, provenance))

# Representative paid-curb time limit per destination tract, from the SDOT
# blockface inventory: length-weighted median PARKING_TIME_LIMIT over paid
# segments. Tracts with no posted limit get NA (-> no re-park penalty).
bf_planar <- blockface_sf %>% st_transform(PLANAR) %>% st_make_valid()
bf_planar$seg_len_m      <- as.numeric(st_length(bf_planar))
bf_planar$time_limit_min <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bf_planar$PARKING_TIME_LIMIT))
bf_planar$is_paid_seg    <- coalesce(as.numeric(bf_planar$PAID_SPACES), 0) > 0
bf_dest <- st_point_on_surface(bf_planar) %>%
  st_join(dest_tracts_sf %>% select(dest_id), join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
curb_limit_by_dest <- bf_dest %>%
  filter(is_paid_seg, is.finite(time_limit_min), !is.na(dest_id)) %>%
  group_by(dest_id) %>%
  summarise(curb_time_limit_min = weighted_median(time_limit_min, seg_len_m),
            .groups = "drop")
dest_attrs <- dest_attrs %>% left_join(curb_limit_by_dest, by = "dest_id")
log_msg(sprintf(
  "Paid-curb time limit: %d of %d dest tracts have one (median %.0f min)",
  sum(is.finite(dest_attrs$curb_time_limit_min)), nrow(dest_attrs),
  suppressWarnings(median(dest_attrs$curb_time_limit_min, na.rm = TRUE))))

# 10c. Compute dwell_for_parking_hr per trip ------------------------------
dwell_purpose_median <- trips_cal %>%
  filter(is.finite(dwell_mins), dwell_mins > 0) %>%
  group_by(dest_purpose) %>%
  summarise(dwell_purpose_med = median(dwell_mins), .groups = "drop")

trips_cal <- trips_cal %>%
  left_join(dwell_purpose_median, by = "dest_purpose") %>%
  mutate(
    dwell_for_parking_min = case_when(
      is.finite(dwell_mins) & dwell_mins > 0 ~ as.numeric(dwell_mins),
      is.finite(dwell_purpose_med)            ~ dwell_purpose_med,
      TRUE                                    ~ 60),
    dwell_for_parking_hr = pmin(dwell_for_parking_min / 60, PARK_MAX_DWELL_HR))

# 10d. Build candidate set per trip and compute logsum -------------------
trips_for_parking <- trips_cal %>%
  left_join(dest_attrs, by = "dest_id") %>%
  mutate(
    paid_rate_tod = case_when(
      tod_bin == "AM"                  ~ rate_morning,
      tod_bin %in% c("Midday", "PM")   ~ rate_day,
      tod_bin == "Evening"             ~ rate_evening,
      TRUE                             ~ 0),
    is_resident_at_dest = origin_id == dest_id)

candidate_long <- bind_rows(
  # Paid curb: re-park each time the posted curb time limit (from the SDOT
  # blockface inventory) is exceeded.
  trips_for_parking %>%
    filter(paid_rate_tod > 0) %>%
    transmute(trip_id, candidate = "paid_curb",
              money = paid_rate_tod * dwell_for_parking_hr,
              search_min = search_min_from_occ(PARK_CURB_OCCUPANCY),
              walk_min = walk_min_from_m(PARK_CURB_WALK_M),
              restriction_min = reparks(dwell_for_parking_hr,
                                        curb_time_limit_min / 60) *
                                (search_min + 2 * walk_min)),
  # Garage: continuous payment, no posted limit -> no re-park.
  trips_for_parking %>%
    filter(!is.na(garage_dist_m), garage_dist_m <= PARK_MAX_CANDIDATE_M) %>%
    transmute(trip_id, candidate = "garage",
              money = coalesce(
                garage_money_tiered(dwell_for_parking_hr,
                                    tg_r1, tg_r2, tg_r3, tg_rall),
                blend_halfmi      * dwell_for_parking_hr,
                blend_group       * dwell_for_parking_hr,
                garage_default_hr * dwell_for_parking_hr),
              search_min = PARK_GARAGE_ACCESS_MIN,
              walk_min = walk_min_from_m(garage_dist_m),
              restriction_min = 0),
  # Free on-street: search/walk doubled in an RPZ; non-permit visitors also
  # face the RPZ visitor limit and must re-park beyond it (residents do not).
  trips_for_parking %>%
    filter(coalesce(unpaid_share, 1) >= PARK_MIN_UNPAID_SHARE) %>%
    mutate(rpz_mult = if_else(dest_rpz == 1,
                              PARK_RPZ_DIFFICULTY_MULTIPLIER, 1),
           free_limit_hr = if_else(dest_rpz == 1 & !is_resident_at_dest,
                                   PARK_RPZ_LIMIT_HR, NA_real_)) %>%
    transmute(trip_id, candidate = "free",
              money = 0,
              search_min = search_min_from_occ(PARK_CURB_OCCUPANCY) * rpz_mult,
              walk_min = walk_min_from_m(PARK_CURB_WALK_M * rpz_mult),
              restriction_min = reparks(dwell_for_parking_hr, free_limit_hr) *
                                (search_min + 2 * walk_min))
) %>%
  mutate(candidate_cost_min =
           usd_to_min(money) + search_min + walk_min + restriction_min)

parking_per_trip <- candidate_long %>%
  group_by(trip_id) %>%
  summarise(
    parking_logsum_min   = parking_logsum(candidate_cost_min),
    parking_money_usd    = expected_under_logit(money,
                            candidate_cost_min),
    parking_search_min   = expected_under_logit(search_min,
                            candidate_cost_min),
    parking_walk_min     = expected_under_logit(walk_min,
                            candidate_cost_min),
    parking_restriction_min = expected_under_logit(restriction_min,
                            candidate_cost_min),
    n_candidates         = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

log_msg("Parking impedance distribution (across all trips):")
print(summary(parking_per_trip[, c("parking_logsum_min", "parking_money_usd",
                                   "parking_search_min", "parking_walk_min",
                                   "parking_restriction_min")]))
log_msg("Median parking money cost by destination area type (drive trips only):")
print(parking_per_trip %>%
        left_join(trips_for_parking %>%
                    select(trip_id, area_type, mode_norm),
                  by = "trip_id") %>%
        filter(mode_norm == "drive") %>%
        group_by(area_type) %>%
        summarise(median_money = median(parking_money_usd),
                  mean_money   = mean(parking_money_usd),
                  n = n(), .groups = "drop"))

# --- Diagnostic: logit (logsum) vs deterministic cheapest-only (argmin) -----
# Sanity check on the choice rule: how different is the probability-weighted
# parking money from simply taking the single lowest-generalized-cost
# candidate? The logit leaks weight onto paid options where "free" is only
# marginally cheapest, so it should sit above the cheapest-only money.
park_argmin <- candidate_long %>%
  group_by(trip_id) %>%
  slice_min(candidate_cost_min, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(trip_id, money_argmin = money, candidate_argmin = candidate)

park_compare <- parking_per_trip %>%
  transmute(trip_id, money_logit = parking_money_usd) %>%
  left_join(park_argmin, by = "trip_id") %>%
  left_join(trips_for_parking %>% select(trip_id, mode_norm, area_type),
            by = "trip_id")

zero_share <- function(x) mean(x < 1e-9, na.rm = TRUE)
log_msg("Parking money: logit logsum vs cheapest-only (all trips):")
print(park_compare %>%
        summarise(mean_logit  = mean(money_logit,  na.rm = TRUE),
                  mean_argmin = mean(money_argmin, na.rm = TRUE),
                  med_logit   = median(money_logit,  na.rm = TRUE),
                  med_argmin  = median(money_argmin, na.rm = TRUE),
                  zero_logit  = zero_share(money_logit),
                  zero_argmin = zero_share(money_argmin)))

log_msg("Parking money: logit vs cheapest-only (drive trips, by area type):")
print(park_compare %>%
        filter(mode_norm == "drive") %>%
        group_by(area_type) %>%
        summarise(n           = n(),
                  mean_logit  = mean(money_logit,  na.rm = TRUE),
                  mean_argmin = mean(money_argmin, na.rm = TRUE),
                  zero_argmin = zero_share(money_argmin),
                  .groups = "drop"))

log_msg("Cheapest-only winning candidate share (drive trips, by area type):")
print(park_compare %>%
        filter(mode_norm == "drive") %>%
        count(area_type, candidate_argmin) %>%
        group_by(area_type) %>%
        mutate(share = round(n / sum(n), 3)) %>%
        ungroup())

trips_cal <- trips_cal %>%
  left_join(parking_per_trip %>%
              select(trip_id, parking_money_usd,
                     parking_search_min, parking_walk_min,
                     parking_restriction_min, parking_logsum_min),
            by = "trip_id") %>%
  mutate(parking_money_usd       = coalesce(parking_money_usd, 0),
         parking_search_min      = coalesce(parking_search_min, 0),
         parking_walk_min        = coalesce(parking_walk_min, 0),
         parking_restriction_min = coalesce(parking_restriction_min, 0))
```

# 10. Per-trip transit fare estimation

Blended per-rider fare from PSRC household composition (KCM 2025 schedule): the
household fare is the average over its members, each priced by type -- children
and students ride free ($0); workers pay an employer-subsidy-adjusted $1.23 (59%
of commuters have an employer-paid ORCA); other adults pay the full $3; and in a
senior-classified or ORCA-LIFT-eligible (<= 200% of the Federal Poverty Level for
the household size) household all paying adults take the reduced $1. Implements
the methodology section's "blend the most likely fares together."

```{r transit-fares}
log_stage("Stage 11: Per-trip transit fare estimation")

# Blended per-rider fare: the average over household members of each member's
# fare. Children and (adult) students ride free ($0). Workers pay an
# employer-subsidy-adjusted fare (59% of commuters have an employer-paid ORCA,
# so expected = $3 x 0.41 = $1.23); other adults pay the full $3. In a
# senior-classified or ORCA-LIFT-eligible (<= 200% FPL for the household size)
# household, all paying adults take the reduced $1 instead. Senior status and
# income are only household-level (lifecycle_class, income bracket midpoint),
# not per-person, so the reduced fare applies to all paying adults there.
estimate_transit_fare <- function(lifecycle_class, numchildren, numadults,
                                  numworkers, num_students, income_k) {
  nch  <- coalesce(numchildren, 0)
  nad  <- pmax(coalesce(numadults, 0), 0)
  nstu <- pmin(coalesce(num_students, 0), nad)               # adult students
  nwrk <- pmin(coalesce(numworkers, 0), pmax(nad - nstu, 0)) # workers (non-student adults)
  noth <- pmax(nad - nstu - nwrk, 0)                         # other adults
  people <- pmax(nad + nch, 1)
  is_senior  <- str_detect(coalesce(lifecycle_class, ""),
                           regex("older adults", ignore_case = TRUE))
  lift_cap   <- TRANSIT_LIFT_FPL_MULT *
                (TRANSIT_FPL_BASE_USD + (people - 1) * TRANSIT_FPL_PER_PERSON)
  is_low_inc <- !is.na(income_k) & income_k * 1000 <= lift_cap
  reduced    <- is_senior | is_low_inc
  adult_contrib <- if_else(reduced,
    TRANSIT_FARE_LOWINC * (nwrk + noth),                       # reduced: all paying adults $1
    TRANSIT_FARE_WORKER * nwrk + TRANSIT_FARE_ADULT * noth)    # else workers $1.23, others $3
  (TRANSIT_FARE_YOUTH * nch + TRANSIT_FARE_STUDENT * nstu + adult_contrib) / people
}

trips_cal <- trips_cal %>%
  mutate(estimated_transit_fare = estimate_transit_fare(
    lifecycle_class, numchildren, numadults, numworkers, num_students,
    income_k))

log_msg("Estimated transit fare distribution (blended per-rider):")
print(summary(trips_cal$estimated_transit_fare))
log_msg(sprintf(
  "Mean fare: $%.2f | share at full $%.2f: %.1f%% | share free: %.1f%%",
  mean(trips_cal$estimated_transit_fare),
  TRANSIT_FARE_ADULT,
  100 * mean(trips_cal$estimated_transit_fare == TRANSIT_FARE_ADULT),
  100 * mean(trips_cal$estimated_transit_fare < 1e-9)))
```

# 11. Build choice-long table for MNL

Produces the long-form 4-row-per-trip data frame used by `mlogit`. Implements
the engineered variables specified in the methodology:

* `walking_min_alt` = walk-mode time (when alt = walk) + walk-to-stop
  time (when alt = transit), both pooled under a single coefficient
  ("generic walking time" — Train & Wilson 2008).
* `transit_total_diff_alt` = (transit_ivtt + transit_wait) − drive_tt
  for the transit alt only, which is the diff specification that
  identifies cleanly off within-OD time-of-day variation.
* `vc_drive_alt` = household vehicle count, drive alt only. Targeted
  alt-specific entry preserves transit-time identification.
* `cost` for drive divided by `travelers_total` to model cost-splitting.

```{r choice-long}
log_stage("Stage 12: Build choice-long table")

# Decision-relevant fields per trip → wide; then crossed with the four alts.
choice_wide <- trips_cal %>%
  transmute(
    trip_id, mode_norm,
    travelers_total = pmax(coalesce(travelers_total, 1L), 1L),
    vehicle_count_n = coalesce(vehicle_count_n, 0),
    is_work = as.integer(str_detect(coalesce(toupper(dest_purpose_cat), ""),
                                    "WORK")),
    walk_tt_use   = walk_tt_raw,
    bike_tt_use   = bike_tt_raw,
    drive_tt_use  = drive_tt_cal,
    transit_walk  = transit_walk_raw,
    transit_wait  = transit_wait_raw,
    transit_ivtt  = transit_ivtt_raw,
    walk_dist_mi, bike_dist_mi, drive_dist_mi, transit_dist_mi,
    parking_money_usd, estimated_transit_fare,
    walk_avail, bike_avail, drive_avail, transit_avail
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transit_ivtt_diff = transit_ivtt - drive_tt_use   # diff vs drive
  )

choice_long_raw <- choice_wide %>%
  tidyr::crossing(alt = c("walk", "bike", "transit", "drive")) %>%
  mutate(
    choice = (mode_norm == alt),
    avail  = case_when(
      alt == "walk"    ~ walk_avail,
      alt == "bike"    ~ bike_avail,
      alt == "transit" ~ transit_avail,
      alt == "drive"   ~ drive_avail),

    # Cost: drive cost is split per traveler; transit fare is per-rider;
    # walk and bike are zero.
    cost = case_when(
      alt == "walk"    ~ 0,
      alt == "bike"    ~ 0,
      alt == "transit" ~ estimated_transit_fare,
      alt == "drive"   ~ (DRIVE_COST_PER_MILE * drive_dist_mi +
                          parking_money_usd) / travelers_total),

    # Per-alt time variables: non-zero only for the matching alt.
    walk_tt_alt    = if_else(alt == "walk",    walk_tt_use,  0),
    bike_tt_alt    = if_else(alt == "bike",    bike_tt_use,  0),
    drive_tt_alt   = if_else(alt == "drive",   drive_tt_use, 0),
    transit_walk_alt      = if_else(alt == "transit", transit_walk, 0),
    transit_wait_alt      = if_else(alt == "transit", transit_wait, 0),
    transit_ivtt_diff_alt = if_else(alt == "transit", transit_ivtt_diff, 0),

    # Engineered variables for the production model.
    walking_min_alt        = walk_tt_alt + transit_walk_alt,
    transit_total_diff_alt = transit_ivtt_diff_alt + transit_wait_alt,
    vc_drive_alt           = if_else(alt == "drive",
                                     as.numeric(vehicle_count_n), 0)
  )

# Drop trips whose chosen alt is unavailable; drop alts that are
# unavailable; require finite values; require exactly 1 chosen and ≥ 2
# alternatives total.
bad_chosen <- choice_long_raw %>%
  filter(choice & !avail) %>%
  distinct(trip_id) %>% pull(trip_id)

choice_long <- choice_long_raw %>%
  filter(!trip_id %in% bad_chosen, avail) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(cost),
    is.finite(walk_tt_alt), is.finite(bike_tt_alt),
    is.finite(drive_tt_alt),
    is.finite(walking_min_alt),
    is.finite(transit_total_diff_alt),
    is.finite(vc_drive_alt),
    is.finite(is_work)
  ) %>%
  group_by(trip_id) %>%
  filter(sum(choice) == 1L, n() >= 2L) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    alt    = factor(alt, levels = c("drive", "walk", "bike", "transit")),
    choice = as.logical(choice),
    trip_id = as.numeric(trip_id))

n_trips_in <- n_distinct(choice_long$trip_id)
log_msg(sprintf("Choice-long rows: %d (%d distinct trips after filtering)",
                nrow(choice_long), n_trips_in))
log_msg("Chosen-mode share in estimation sample:")
print(choice_long %>%
        filter(choice) %>%
        count(alt) %>%
        mutate(share = round(n / sum(n), 3)))
```

# 12. Estimate MNL

```{r estimate-mnl}
log_stage("Stage 13: Estimate MNL")

t0 <- Sys.time()
mnl <- mlogit::mlogit(
  choice ~ cost + walking_min_alt + bike_tt_alt + drive_tt_alt +
           transit_total_diff_alt + vc_drive_alt | is_work,
  data = choice_long,
  shape = "long",
  chid.var = "trip_id",
  alt.var  = "alt",
  drop.index = FALSE,
  reflevel = "drive")
log_done("MNL fit", t0)

cat("\n")
print(summary(mnl))
```

# 13. Output: VOTTs, coefficient table, fitted model, run metadata

```{r outputs}
log_stage("Stage 14: Outputs")

co <- coef(mnl)
se <- sqrt(diag(stats::vcov(mnl)))
beta_cost <- co[["cost"]]

vott <- function(time_var) {
  if (time_var %in% names(co)) co[[time_var]] / beta_cost * 60
  else NA_real_
}

coef_table <- tibble(
  variable = names(co),
  beta     = unname(co),
  se       = unname(se),
  z        = unname(co / se),
  p        = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(unname(co / se)))),
  vott_usd_per_hr = if_else(
    names(co) %in% c("walking_min_alt", "bike_tt_alt", "drive_tt_alt",
                     "transit_total_diff_alt"),
    unname(co) / beta_cost * 60, NA_real_))

print(coef_table)

vott_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c("drive", "walking", "bike", "transit_total_diff",
             "walking_to_transit_total_ratio",
             "wait_time_implicit_ratio_to_drive"),
  value = c(vott("drive_tt_alt"),
            vott("walking_min_alt"),
            vott("bike_tt_alt"),
            vott("transit_total_diff_alt"),
            co[["walking_min_alt"]] / co[["transit_total_diff_alt"]],
            NA_real_))

log_msg("VOTT summary ($/hr unless ratio):")
print(vott_summary)

# Save artifacts
saveRDS(mnl, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "mnl_fit.rds"))
saveRDS(choice_long, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "choice_long.rds"))
saveRDS(trips_cal, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "trips_calibrated.rds"))
write_csv(coef_table, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "coefficients.csv"))
write_csv(vott_summary, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vott.csv"))

# Run metadata for reproducibility
metadata <- list(
  run_finished_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  total_seconds = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .log_start_time,
                                       units = "secs")),
  n_threads = N_VCPU,
  java_heap_gb = JAVA_HEAP_GB,
  inputs = list(
    trips_csv = file_signature(params$trips_csv),
    households_csv = file_signature(params$households_csv),
    osm_pbf = file_signature(params$osm_pbf),
    gtfs_zip = file_signature(params$gtfs_zip),
    base_monday = format(BASE_MONDAY, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    parking_tiers_url = params$parking_tiers_url,
    parking_rpz_url = params$parking_rpz_url,
    parking_garages_url = params$parking_garages_url),
  sample = list(
    intra_seattle_trips = nrow(trips_seattle),
    estimation_trips = n_trips_in,
    estimation_rows = nrow(choice_long)),
  model = list(
    formula = "choice ~ cost + walking_min_alt + bike_tt_alt + drive_tt_alt + transit_total_diff_alt + vc_drive_alt | is_work",
    log_likelihood = as.numeric(stats::logLik(mnl)),
    coefficients = as.list(co),
    standard_errors = as.list(se),
    vott_usd_per_hr = list(
      drive = vott("drive_tt_alt"),
      walking = vott("walking_min_alt"),
      bike = vott("bike_tt_alt"),
      transit_total_diff = vott("transit_total_diff_alt"))),
  package_versions = list(
    R = R.version.string,
    r5r = as.character(packageVersion("r5r")),
    dodgr = as.character(packageVersion("dodgr")),
    mlogit = as.character(packageVersion("mlogit")),
    sf = as.character(packageVersion("sf")),
    tigris = as.character(packageVersion("tigris")),
    tidycensus = as.character(packageVersion("tidycensus")),
    mgcv = as.character(packageVersion("mgcv"))))

jsonlite::write_json(metadata, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "run_metadata.json"),
                     auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE, force = TRUE)

log_msg(sprintf("All outputs written to %s", OUTPUT_DIR))
log_msg(sprintf("Total wall-clock time: %.1f minutes",
                as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .log_start_time,
                                    units = "mins"))))
```

# 14. Shutdown

```{r shutdown}
log_stage("Stage 15: Shutdown")
try(r5r::stop_r5(r5r_network), silent = TRUE)
log_msg("Pipeline complete.")
```
